Hi Peter,

Today is Presidents’ Day. If you’re like us, you might be spending today thinking about the fact that **America has failed to elect a qualified woman as president TWICE** in the last decade alone.

In the years following both of those elections, we have endured a President that has brought blatant misogyny and outdated views about gender back to the mainstream.

[**We refuse to accept this as normal. That’s why at Her Bold Move, we are on a mission to elect women up and down the ballot until we have finally shattered our nation’s highest glass ceiling once and for all.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/hbm-pac/?refcode=EM_F_260216presidents_N_JZ_90DO_13_G_TestA_L1&amount=20.26)

There are qualified, brilliant women in this country who are just waiting in the wings to bring about real change. The would-be female presidents who have been waiting far too long for their turn to lead. Policymakers who, perhaps, _haven’t_ been recorded bragging about grabbing women by the genitals or appeared to be best friends with the most notorious sex trafficker in modern history... We believe these women are out there.

[**In honor of Presidents’ Day, help us continue to support and uplift incredible, pro-WOMEN women candidates by donating $20.26 today.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/125491559/601957831/1701071684?refcode=EM_F_260216presidents_N_JZ_90DO_13_G_TestA_L2&amount=20.26&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNy8xLzg4NDk1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjA5NTQ1ZjAwLTQ0MGItZjExMS04MzJlLTAwMjI0ODJhOTczMyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=VBNzjz0jwe0GSP52afZKlg2zPG9hhVCr71_FwXcAkcc=)

As research from the _Wilson Center_ points out, “Although the presence of a woman in leadership does not automatically ensure positive change, empirical evidence underscores the broader impact of having __more women__ in public decision-making roles. **This shift is associated with higher economic growth, improved gender equality, and greater social investment in education, healthcare, and environmental protection.”**

_We have never had a woman president but we have had: at least 15 presidents accused of sexual misconduct, at least 20 presidents who didn't believe women should have the right to vote, and at least 2 presidents with strong ties to a sex trafficker._ At least one woman has held the highest office in more than _a third_ of countries in the world. As you know, the U.S. is not one of them. In 2024, Mexico elected its first female president, Claudia Sheinbaum, making her the first female president in North America. Since then, she has maintained an approval rating of around 70%. She has thrived in her role as Mexico’s first woman president – including enshrining women’s right to equality and establishing the Ministry of Women.

Women in Mexico didn’t gain the right to vote for president until 1953. Not to mention, as recently as 2021, the country had very few women in government. Now, Mexico has surpassed the United States in gender parity. **We want to see that kind of progress happen here.** That is why Her Bold Move has worked with female candidates from nearly every state in America, and has seen the challenges and disturbing realities women face when they enter politics in this country. On a daily basis, we see how our candidates deal with misogyny, double standards, sexism, and an onslaught of violent and sexual threats.

It’s harder to run for office as a woman – and it’s nearly impossible to combat the deep-seated sexism that has left countless glass ceilings intact for far too long.

As we honor some of the greatest past leaders of our nation, we also want to reimagine Presidents’ Day as an opportunity for reflection. What will it take to finally see a woman in the Oval Office? The work we do at Her Bold Move is getting us closer to an answer to that question.

[**At Her Bold Move, we’re working with some of the most phenomenal female leaders in the nation – the ones who might have what it takes to be our first-ever female president. We have a chance to make the US a better country for ALL by electing pro-choice, qualified women into positions of power – but we can’t do it without YOUR HELP.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/125491566/601957841/1701071684?refcode=EM_F_260216presidents_N_JZ_90DO_13_G_TestB_L3&amount=20.26&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNy8xLzg4NDk1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjA5NTQ1ZjAwLTQ0MGItZjExMS04MzJlLTAwMjI0ODJhOTczMyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=VBNzjz0jwe0GSP52afZKlg2zPG9hhVCr71_FwXcAkcc=)

Founder and President
Her Bold Move

| | , **This campaign is not powered by insiders. It is powered by people.** Over the past months, leaders and organizations from across Texas have stepped forward to endorse our campaign for Attorney General. Environmental advocates. Labor leaders. Young Democrats. Black Democrats. Tejano Democrats. Women’s organizations. Neighborhood clubs. Grassroots activists. Elected officials and former public servants. [](https://jaworskifortexas.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2e1f50319ad85f5f9e5c11ac9&id=92b40ede73&e=5d8d80652b) **Taken together, these endorsements represent something important: a broad, growing coalition of Texans who believe the Office of the Attorney General should serve the people, not the powerful.** As Michelle Davis of **Lone Star Left** wrote in their endorsement, **_“[Joe] prioritizes credibility over spectacle. He talks about consequences several steps down the line, rather than the next news cycle. He treats the Attorney General as a steward of a legal framework that has to keep functioning after he leaves.”_** She understands what is truly at stake in this race: _**“[The AG] decide[s] what the State of Texas will defend. They decide what the State of Texas will stop defending. They decide whether the state escalates the conflict or backs off. They decide whether the law gets used like a tool... or like a weapon.”**_ The AG can and _should_ use the law and its power for the people. It _should_ defend the Constitution. It _should_ protect the vulnerable. It _should_ fight corruption and stand up to federal and state overreach when it crosses the line. **It should not be another weapon wielded by a small circle of Austin insiders who treat government like a private club.** [](https://jaworskifortexas.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2e1f50319ad85f5f9e5c11ac9&id=4e92e45e70&e=5d8d80652b) [**This growing list of endorsements tells me something simple: Democrats across Texas are ready for an Attorney General who will not compromise with bullies and will not flinch when the Constitution is on the line. Will you stand with these endorsers today and help us run through the finish line on March 3? Contribute today.**](https://jaworskifortexas.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2e1f50319ad85f5f9e5c11ac9&id=bc086d4be0&e=5d8d80652b) Early voting begins tomorrow, Tuesday, February 17, and runs through Friday, February 27. The Texas Democratic Primary is March 3. Momentum is building. Now we turn it into votes. Onward to the polls,

It is powered by people. Over the past months, leaders and organizations from across Texas have stepped forward to endorse our campaign for Attorney General. Environmental advocates. Labor leaders. Young Democrats. Black Democrats. Tejano Democrats. Women’s organizations. Neighborhood clubs. Grassroots activists. Elected officials and former public servants. Taken together, these endorsements represent something important: a broad, growing coalition of Texans who believe the Office of the Attorney General should serve the people, not the powerful. As Michelle Davis of Lone Star Left wrote in their endorsement, “[Joe] prioritizes credibility over spectacle. He talks about consequences several steps down the line, rather than the next news cycle. He treats the Attorney General as a steward of a legal framework that has to keep functioning after he leaves.” She understands what is truly at stake in this race: “[The AG] decide[s] what the State of Texas will defend. They decide what the State of Texas will stop defending. They decide whether the state escalates the conflict or backs off. They decide whether the law gets used like a tool... or like a weapon.” The AG can and should use the law and its power for the people. It should defend the Constitution. It should protect the vulnerable. It should fight corruption and stand up to federal and state overreach when it crosses the line. It should not be another weapon wielded by a small circle of Austin insiders who treat government like a private club. Early voting begins tomorrow, Tuesday, February 17, and runs through Friday, February 27. The Texas Democratic Primary is March 3. Momentum is building. Now we turn it into votes. Presidents Day is supposed to make us proud of our leaders. But honestly, looking at Washington right now, it’s hard to feel anything but disappointment. We have a president in Donald Trump who has made corruption a way of governing. He treats our laws like suggestions and our institutions like his personal piggy bank. It’s a national disgrace. But here’s what I’ve learned running for Congress here in Pennsylvania’s 7th District: **this corruption doesn’t stop at the White House gates.** It has partners in Congress. Too many of our representatives have become silent accomplices. They look the other way. They make excuses. They’ve traded their backbone for a seat at the table, allowing this rot to spread. Ryan Mackenzie has had every chance to stand up to this administration’s self-dealing and abuses. Instead, he has decided to stand down. body:
Throughout our history, these presidents denounced gerrymandering as undemocratic.
|
---

Our 23rd president, Benjamin Harrison, called it a form of “political robbery.”
President Ronald Reagan called for “an end to the antidemocratic and un-American practice of gerrymandering congressional districts.”
**“I'm making redistricting a priority because there is no issue it doesn't touch. There is no better opportunity to bend the great arc of history toward justice. And to bend it, we've all got to push together.”**

— Barack Obama, 44th President of the United States
And President Obama made a point of singling out the fight for fair maps among his top priorities because, as he put it, “there is no issue it doesn’t touch. There is no better opportunity to bend the great arc of history toward justice. And to bend it, we’ve all got to push together.”
This Presidents Day, we’re reflecting on the history of U.S. presidents who have stood up for a fairer, truly representative democracy — regardless of their party affiliation. You have to believe each and every one of them would be horrified by the redistricting crisis some politicians have thrust our nation into.
Here’s the thing: Even the elected officials who are carving out districts to keep themselves in power know they’re stripping away the rights of millions of voters. They know it’s tantamount to cheating.
**That’s why Redistricting Action is on a mission to stop these mid-decade power grabs and pass critical reforms. And to bend it, we've all got to push together.” — Barack Obama, 44th President of the United States And President Obama made a point of singling out the fight for fair maps among his top priorities because, as he put it, “there is no issue it doesn’t touch. There is no better opportunity to bend the great arc of history toward justice. And to bend it, we’ve all got to push together.” This Presidents Day, we’re reflecting on the history of U.S. presidents who have stood up for a fairer, truly representative democracy — regardless of their party affiliation. You have to believe each and every one of them would be horrified by the redistricting crisis some politicians have thrust our nation into. Here’s the thing: Even the elected officials who are carving out districts to keep themselves in power know they’re stripping away the rights of millions of voters. They know it’s tantamount to cheating. That’s why Redistricting Action is on a mission to stop these mid-decade power grabs and pass critical reforms. Hi friends,
Today our country celebrates Presidents' Day - and if this day finds you feeling angry, frustrated, or fed up with our current president's nonsense, I understand.
I am, too.
**But one thing I 'm **_**not**_**feeling is hopeless. Instead, I 'm feeling fired up, motivated, and more hopeFUL than ever.**
Because I've got tons of people like _you_ on my team. Thanks to you, a new poll shows our race for U.S. Senate here in Michigan is tied. But I'm not planning on staying tied - I'm planning to _win_.
**[Together, we're going to keep Michigan blue, take back the Senate for Democrats this November, and stop Donald Trump in his tracks.](https://substack.com/redirect/07ba1c1b-433f-4a11-babf-2ab4a8242aaf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
I'm not saying it's going to be easy. It's no secret Donald Trump's cruel policies and dangerous agenda have hurt families and communities in Michigan and every corner of the country.
Never forget that:
📉 He gutted Medicaid and cut health insurance subsidies.
🧪 He installed RFK Jr., a dangerous conspiracy theorist, as HHS secretary.
💸 He enacted reckless tariffs that raised prices and cost families thousands of dollars in 2025.
❌ He deployed ICE and the U.S. military in American cities.
🥶 And he's done _nothing_ to lower costs for working people - here in Michigan or anywhere else. In fact, he's on record saying he "couldn't care less" if auto prices go up.
Meanwhile, I've spent my career fighting for the good people who keep this state running. I helped save 200,000 Michigan jobs during President Obama's auto rescue. Just last year, I defended science, fought to lower costs, and delivered real results for working families, including**$13 million** returned to folks in my district.
Donald Trump is hell-bent as ever on maintaining his MAGA cronies' control of the Senate so he can keep doing whatever the heck he wants with ZERO pushback or retribution. And he's made it clear he's already laser-focused on our race.
But - and this is important - _we have the power to stop him._ It starts by keeping Michigan blue, and it's going to take ALL of us to do it.
Michigan's Senate race is as mission-critical as it gets, and that's why it's a **top target** for the GOP.
_The Cook Political Report_ ranks it a **Toss Up**.**** Analysts at _The Hill_ say we're one of the **most likely to flip red** , so now Trump's megadonor friends, including a Texas oil billionaire, are spending **millions** to buy this seat for MAGA Mike Rogers.
But the good news is that poll after poll shows I'm the strongest Democrat to beat Rogers - and as I mentioned, a recent one shows us TIED. Our race is neck and neck - so we're hustling.
**Because if we win this seat, we can flip the Senate, make Trump a lame duck president for the rest of his term, and STOP more of his MAGA agenda from going into effect.**
Are you in? Because I promise you, that future is within reach. But I've said it before, and I'll say it again: This campaign isn't about me. It's about _us_.
And going up against millions in outside spending from the MAGA machine, I need this grassroots team's support today, tomorrow, and every step of the way to make a brighter future our reality.
**[If you're ready to help, I'd truly appreciate any amount you can chip in today to fuel this campaign.](https://substack.com/redirect/07ba1c1b-433f-4a11-babf-2ab4a8242aaf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/07ba1c1b-433f-4a11-babf-2ab4a8242aaf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
I'm hopeful for everything we can accomplish together, and I'm ready to put in the work for my family and yours. I thank you for being by my side in this fight.
With grit, gratitude, hope, and determination,
Haley
* * *

A personal note from Haley 👋

I'm a lifelong Michigander and the daughter of small-business owners. I've spent my career fighting for Michigan's working families - and now I'm running for the U.S. Senate to keep standing up for the people I love.

But here's the truth: Senate control could come down to Michigan. And Trump and his megadonors know it. That's why they're gearing up to spend tens of millions to defeat me and hand this seat to a MAGA Republican.

I need your help to fight back. This race will be one of the most competitive - and expensive - in the country, and I'm counting on grassroots support to win.

If you're with me, will you chip in today?
[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/07ba1c1b-433f-4a11-babf-2ab4a8242aaf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

name: Crystal & Jason via ActionNetwork.org
subject: Strengthening Indigenous Environmental Organizing & Infrastructure Monitoring in the Southeast
body:
Expanding Indigenous organizing to monitor pipelines and data centers. | | | Hey Friends! We wanted to check in with our friends, family, and allies. We’re not going to pretend it’s been easy. This winter has been harsh—not just environmentally, but mentally and emotionally as well. The last two months have been exhausting. The pressure, the uncertainty, the constant organizing, the strategy thoughts — it takes a toll. [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3-fyDnf0MZkZOQ033LB4o6yMvt7Xkzemo-urgTI61Lz5aG8zjyJcdSi8XI_gxUCUvGTFECfH9_s3fj0GZFoUk_jrmhySrMJVnxDZ8MrDApx_9Bd8b78dJSfkkZOIFVF38EecSm19_00wOTDwHM3banG6Ohjaiw9XbcC6dNqXAs_tK3Pt-53iv73mmhBNotXBTq7em08ZjLOFu2acndxYNddduXwXdlUE3500pLPhNlAoNIiPaHfikh0jyk5hS5rq3DcZNHZUDF1BuWhP7YBSX5jzU-KoqvIZM597Ar-ooov-btZlMjbmVjCx6cJrd0BBe1gkh1kgwhDLwHK5nyMRyHIHkv-O7RBn5JAaHiFsh1dHRalx481Ds4yEzSyoRQFlItmGdZAzx3fNqpJ_49Gys1HWxg2zO0T8HiQ7X4wEIF_OS2UO7FUrucKSxvvjInS8QzkSmALyS2fVHSvjxOyWxES/4o7/AcndMgyJQgO3wWdO6r2bZA/h0/h001.fOBLjQkR7F8FX-tpfkUHyUNJIvfltsZG2_PYrZbtiYM) **But we are still here. Still standing. Still organizing. Still fighting.** Today, I’m writing to share an urgent expansion of our environmental justice work at 7 Directions of Service — and to invite you to stand with us as we strengthen Indigenous-led environmental protection across the Southeast at a critical moment. [Fundraising](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3-fyDnf0MZkZOQ033LB4o6yMvt7Xkzemo-urgTI61Lz5aG8zjyJcdSi8XI_gxUCUvHWagSYKK3bcE_jSM_g_9jGAoIHIvPy0rC3b0Jg55MVE2xqF-bRfgaR7lcsN07ImDozVoA47Wj-boBVOEwB0FbfhsVlNf2dPijYfNPD1jlk6cCAkiVPr13IBSxKIjkk45TzsEs5mOvmbJURojZGaULpnDs8JmcT4nVIyIYuZ0gdXKm_s-BXedmHDHhBxZmV3TFL0Bpi2WuBk3jfuD7kcj_eecTM5TLW8oAS1CePWqfWIrrPRaCbITnzJY9Tu4SGLSM86UwFWyImm45QX9lvvm66ZKDAmdWO-DtKIM9vgtOo3Rh23kehliJsJxJnMBzQf_HZn7o8vKoeMit2nnXUXqiDYfaPqsuytHpZRvUUso50R4tOQsz5D-2rAqjpPI9IeqVuKqJX16UX5pBsQDbD5Rqy/4o7/AcndMgyJQgO3wWdO6r2bZA/h1/h001.8EMEIbb1g5NxvqfabT3CLjd5pH6dMT_4fijejg_vJJY) has never been my favorite part of this work. I would much rather be organizing communities, building coalitions, and protecting land and water. But the truth is, this movement only continues because people like you believe in it enough to invest in it. And right now, we need that investment. The three major pipeline projects — the Southeast Supply Enhancement (SSEP) pipeline, the Mountain Valley Pipeline Southgate Extension, and the T-15 expansion — threaten Indigenous communities, rural communities, waterways, and sacred sites from Virginia to Louisiana. We are fighting back. For years, our coalition has worked to educate, organize, and mobilize Indigenous nations and frontline communities to resist environmental destruction. From coalition-building to public education, legal engagement, direct action, and cultural protection, we have defended the land and water that sustain us. But as these projects move from permitting into the implementation and community engagement phases, the need for coordinated,[ on-the-ground presence ](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3-fyDnf0MZkZOQ033LB4o6yMvt7Xkzemo-urgTI61Lz5aG8zjyJcdSi8XI_gxUCUvE59fzBqHbzzntRrAvr5QQrnmoQ_m_MNEe46vSeilWY6bG_GKK9ZYRff0QpsiXj6UgdXVa1_ky36OkaNVBB4w-fiDHE8PUpNJTrKxCXvlfkOoJEnBTVDHd2pZb6khuW_Nca8c6HoLoOApfoFK-gm31fSdlzBN5sJMmUKtXz97CRVeiyWBRMqUcnJE1tziLvOX_3pBhkijM0kd7FMNvaJtCpOzvl6MJVKkj55RK5hFNJhnOQNWYNM5mT4ExnLK--I9qUyikpIr9xzyL8OWyuBmJI2fL03gIW2_gzs8pipmqFK-SjJKWiMbx-kn6cmGdcWrYhswGdDF-a-G2J4KujqT3z0PwVTAuEeSUGq0SVLZa0X7pb8gckuhuFxCAUYDmn8D8Fd5-lGJR4mJyC9HFrU7Ee/4o7/AcndMgyJQgO3wWdO6r2bZA/h2/h001.mXCxBl-cl8iOwlodblbTXSrK0PTHbsbIKEdQVs2WQ7Q)has intensified. To meet this moment, we have hired an Indigenous organizer based in South Carolina to lead regional organizing across South Carolina, Georgia, and Alabama. This role focuses on community education, coalition-building, and rapid response to ecological threats, while ensuring that Indigenous voices remain central to public decision-making. As pipeline development advances, our work shifts accordingly. We are mobilizing directly along the proposed routes—organizing affected communities, building regional coalitions, and establishing community-based “watch teams” to monitor activities, document impacts, and ensure transparency. These watch teams provide real-time accountability as construction and related activities unfold. At the same time, we are strengthening multi-state organizing infrastructure so communities across the Southeast are informed, prepared, and connected. Additionally, [we have hired](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3-fyDnf0MZkZOQ033LB4o6yMvt7Xkzemo-urgTI61Lz5aG8zjyJcdSi8XI_gxUCUvFRJbeaZP48-gHClvPvpASokoM3TrKONr5FNuX_YtPb12WNmt0ebDrVm3bZj39aqLk9oCqG8QkJlbZklJnMiJtLcjZKJ0SEGq-8YD47jDV7wYE4oHJiKHw7WkBwWQnihFfhGT-DCqLmE5rdV_ocUt3O2Fk7ufvp-yJbZyOTa_S6qeVCvWQPPb09mQQalqoIKRd9Nveez931qxeNLhl_UHaEddIF44yoUqPEWbgJmAukgWRAXESFuq6Ed5_WpeTmdG5qrDW6AXqf69ZGNH0Prtp885u9ToVcp2w5BtJvrVFA2lJ8g9WuMoTaPKz-TBQOby3rQ5RVK_q2R2p0_C3R5SA4LXNRd6rZDUTxa-s_wBOsiY5n2g_bjBX1OohoqqXHe78iYF0EJtiODjBMkI4DyzKe/4o7/AcndMgyJQgO3wWdO6r2bZA/h3/h001.5cfY4Qx7DLwOZeU1eLGvRF0bSv6ryk5dF7aH_pHOL8s) a dedicated Data Center Organizer. We are seeing energy companies advance large-scale data center developments throughout the Southeast and structure new pipeline and utility infrastructure to support them. These projects often move quickly, with limited public awareness of their water usage, energy demands, land impacts, and long-term environmental consequences. By proactively organizing around data centers, we are addressing how emerging digital infrastructure is driving fossil fuel expansion and reshaping regional energy policy. **This expansion strengthens our ability to:** • Support frontline Indigenous communities facing environmental harm
• Protect sacred sites, waterways, and biodiversity
• Teams will monitor pipeline construction, water quality, and related infrastructure impacts
• Address the intersection of data centers and fossil fuel expansion
• Build long-term regional organizing infrastructure
• Integrate Traditional Ecological Knowledge into environmental advocacy
• Coordinate cross-state environmental justice campaigns **However, we are facing a[critical funding crisis](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3-fyDnf0MZkZOQ033LB4o6yMvt7Xkzemo-urgTI61Lz5aG8zjyJcdSi8XI_gxUCUvEQh0W_S4JuJL1j9b6xLye28cAs89774eYwBSHOrYHBI5MX1dqjZEXKSQhxiYUwp3ByaE32UwMDq9KeFucD4IG-RZiQHkFNjspJnkH8Pr_E6TQlGIIq-JeKqYDbgoVKQElrYbEnAb25L8wWucskkFbSRo2h308USwjU5P-5QX53l3Lt01mcPXC9KA0cKwjdNM4WHgV15cXwpQ7MQNZf557ZzWvvxAIGTFyrGgkiNA7jH1ZTqYucq3UocTC0o8Vq8PdWyk675vT3cAp8WIzhpX36hsapE9SIpz7dHdI1AdBvexXYjnnjfRjvedbCSqvu4Ihj3cfBL8JSX3QDbRxc8Yg4Jzp4bSsit_RSSHG7ZymPem1drjPQwEYJe5alaW5RBdON7q3T7KMiw0ZfBEI5eH6J/4o7/AcndMgyJQgO3wWdO6r2bZA/h4/h001.x0OA99dQsEDspeZGjjj8AqrCrqeACKEDFRT1aHAK8A8) at the very moment this work is most urgent.** In the fourth quarter of 2024, we lost three significant funders, resulting in a $300,000 shortfall. We also spent two years preparing for Justice40-related grant funding, which was unexpectedly eliminated in January 2025. While we have secured two new funders, their support does not cover the losses we sustained. [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3-fyDnf0MZkZOQ033LB4o6yMvt7Xkzemo-urgTI61Lz5aG8zjyJcdSi8XI_gxUCUvFFieb4cJ34JrzrypmQonFcJ2gTtXY9bkZgxaACFbi0MryCnNMbFnjCZHU0CjeDRqvAES_YXmDYkzu3qaLiHcGnw3FVwjElMyunLfKRDOm8iBwioqqZKN2FjKaHf1nsXcG6ofk0nm1UQZi9Y2x9jToRQbNaUSvyNWY8cQkTXPyius50bjshggistTq1u0Ke367D-h5YbNApU1fXda6ZFSDP8DZsOPv7vHSAssUNTQXL31bfwvfW9BLBQ_3xh5damrOX-KEmyeBPfhF_s_R18E7OPYb3rvCIC0ZeK5qC6qrdYta0kjo3TC0iBmzXxCA1dEFirEjmIg-WeIQzbVif1CClEeknpePx7_8RL2CpP6HPVU4K-zjCHY2-wO9TnoLlmlEzSQGMarpEU7kIaYsiJvdH/4o7/AcndMgyJQgO3wWdO6r2bZA/h5/h001.pwnDzOrwg2UtCNm99I95fZA-r-y1-7m4GO9oFp5J2bw)
These funding cuts come precisely when pipeline construction, energy expansion, and industrial development are accelerating across the Southeast. Without [sustained investment,](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3-fyDnf0MZkZOQ033LB4o6yMvt7Xkzemo-urgTI61Lz5aG8zjyJcdSi8XI_gxUCUvELCAUQ4E2FC3coKTENEdCq31mzYv-Gc1HBg5D_OgL6krTdY2DAHICKSstL97gEXHYUq5pbJRTM_7C-GcFVCT0uYUE_PzC6V9UUQZyu4wdHj23PYqjamqtX9SOqkhtTAH5k83jMedVpYtcxBzZYlORLyPI0Nx5VN9eX9MWi5fpIRxvMGcx2SXHzQVWYlrQYrZZNPBhbIvXxMkFlxqoiN6jwuepVTFOyhFvxAu0dcgylYHwgWK5GHJ9WoSp5yD6jgPdQ2J5Jusa2IkAF3xNehwibMdJcw91jahyOSEDbffQDcWmh3Bl60Gzl5q06kW7dU-Xt2kGySv2h4fkGKShw-SIHb56vVJe6rKJFZJpxWrZt3yzgGaPxzJp03wyNUUD2kRAnhs3bm_YMBZSZdjYIt8T1/4o7/AcndMgyJQgO3wWdO6r2bZA/h6/h001.dBKEFZcTnehKoSnMoZUJUf6sFEcAKl8EM-UzPGIP4qE) our ability to maintain on-the-ground organizers, support watch teams, and provide regional coordination will be severely constrained. We are seeking immediate support to stabilize and grow this regional organizing infrastructure — including personnel, travel, community engagement resources, monitoring tools, and policy analysis capacity. An investment at this moment directly protects land, water, sacred sites, and community health across multiple states. We would welcome the opportunity to discuss how this work aligns with your priorities and how you can help sustain Indigenous-led environmental defense across the Southeast. If you are ready to support this effort, please consider making a contribution [here:](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3-fyDnf0MZkZOQ033LB4o6yMvt7Xkzemo-urgTI61Lz5aG8zjyJcdSi8XI_gxUCUvH-cMZtaKahEt5MJLd0gvGItrWLj_lAJB7HXNmJ-DqCM9yffmjt2rgVIunorNWSMJyoqxyV8CIedCbl5qrJVOEeQF231Wlr0fqVaBSTthtQ1yDrt8gtDGkoEt5V9ph9tc-0RcPbmGb5KoZuFg9L5uf0s7HyDZnLJqVvT2udq9kLqZcf3oyul2jsjFkOIKyxcAzIInVzcc0o85c3blH_uTmFmJLg4PHefg4Gd4xq62Qk2KceoCiLoxxuDon_J-OFEqam3nzH6_sJ15rEoOzFdmvmBBgbWZpfbGwDhjtN7vWx_eBrWCxbTrHpBKuiugES5bVdYkU8Cpta-k4KUVLaW9GBgSNiZye_uzW2hKjnYVIzi-Ryfo6fvLYwcOCxrEgIL4xsCA3OzsujDlqIX-sRdni2/4o7/AcndMgyJQgO3wWdO6r2bZA/h7/h001.5mJcEikFSdJ4gNQ4Hn1VNltoGTV3xt2AkMy_tG80QmU)

We are seeking immediate support to stabilize and grow this regional organizing infrastructure — including personnel, travel, community engagement resources, monitoring tools, and policy analysis capacity. An investment at this moment directly protects land, water, sacred sites, and community health across multiple states. We would welcome the opportunity to discuss how this work aligns with your priorities and how you can help sustain Indigenous-led environmental defense across the Southeast. name: Houston Gaines
subject: The Latest from the Capitol
body:
Read up-to-date information from the Gold Dome
| | | | |
---
| Happy President's Day!
Legislative work at the State Capitol continues to move quickly. The House is at full speed and focused on major budget decisions and key policy priorities for the year. Please read below for an update on the latest from the Gold Dome.
---
| |
---
| |
---
| LEGISLATIVE UPDATES
---
| Legislative activity has accelerated as committees meet, legislation advances, and members focus on key policy priorities for the year. With committees fully engaged, the House has resumed hearings on legislation and budget proposals, and the Rules Committee continues to send legislation to the House Floor for consideration.
As we moved into February, much of the House's attention centered on the Amended Fiscal Year 2026 (AFY 2026) budget. The House Appropriations Committee advanced House Bill 973, the House's version of the amended budget. This budget funds state government through June 30, 2026, and reflects updated revenue estimates and pressing needs across the state.
The budget prioritizes tax relief, education, healthcare, public safety, transportation and behavioral health, while maintaining a balanced and fiscally responsible approach. A major priority this session is providing property tax relief to Georgia homeowners. The amended budget allocates $850 million from the state's surplus to fully fund the Homeowner Tax Relief Grant program, allowing for the maximum exemption on assessed home values for qualifying homesteads in the 2026 tax year. This investment reflects ongoing efforts to help families manage rising property taxes and afford to stay in their homes. Should this program remain in the budget, it will result in an approximate $500 savings for every homeowner this year.
The House also made significant investments in education, including funding for the new needs-based DREAMS Scholarship program, additional support for the HOPE Scholarship, pay supplements for teachers and school staff, and new resources to support literacy, school safety and workforce readiness. These investments are aimed at strengthening Georgia's education system from early learning through higher education.
In addition, the amended budget includes substantial funding for transportation and infrastructure, with major investments in interstate express lanes, local road resurfacing and rural bridge repair. Specifically, it includes dedicated express lane expansion on I-75 in Henry County and $200 million for continued improvements along SR 316 from metro Atlanta toward Athens. These projects are designed to improve safety, reduce congestion and support economic growth.
Public safety, healthcare and behavioral health were also key areas of focus. The House budget provides funding for prison security upgrades, inmate healthcare, rural medical education and clinic development, and significant investments to address Georgia's behavioral health needs which includes funding to begin the design and construction of a new regional psychiatric hospital in Atlanta. The budget also fully addresses the funding deficit within the Division of Family and Children Services to ensure continued support for foster care and reunification services.
---
| |
---
| In addition to our work on the state budget, I was pleased to advance House Bill 295 that I authored through committee. HB 295 focuses on protecting property owners by providing landowners with a clear path to seek compensation when local governments fail to enforce existing laws or address ongoing public nuisances that result in financial harm. This legislation is about accountability and ensuring that property owners are not left bearing the cost of inaction. When a local government fails to enforce laws relating to camping, loitering, panhandling, shoplifting, and similar issues - a property owner can seek compensation if they incurred expenses (i.e. security cameras, fencing, etc.) as a result or if the value of their property was diminished. HB 295 received committee approval, and my hope is that it will soon see a Floor vote.
The House also passed bills addressing medical licensing, mental health, rural healthcare access, newborn safety, veterans, early literacy, and protections for elderly and disabled Georgians. We also welcomed the Chief Justice of the Supreme Court to deliver the annual State of the Judiciary Address, which highlighted judicial independence, court safety and efforts to improve outcomes for children in foster care.
As we continue moving through this Session, my focus remains on passing a balanced and responsible budget, delivering meaningful tax relief, strengthening education and workforce readiness, improving access to healthcare, and ensuring public safety across our state. With key deadlines approaching, the days ahead will be busy as the House works with the Senate to finalize the amended budget and begin shaping the Fiscal Year 2027 budget.
---
| |
---
| IN THE NEWS
---
|
# [Rep. Gaines to pursue lower homeowner taxes, more](https://a89bm49ab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001p7PuVAQB9Yp9bZZ_g7Vz0i5UAcmvoU_g6TlAZa9aPXR0xs4DkE20JJA-T4H0S2jdrAUQpJAH8ujZ4_v84Apn__c4wQ4pRaE-dvnzdboCKnB60pZEF85iv29HzJOthBiJYBgao2SBljb88thAmvISEI25DYEyfqdBBY3ISZKVyB-cIkYqoVefe3b04ZRBNQtKSjDAKL4ETaLQzEmEGwSSeFd6sFYFsJchF93zgKUS38eKT9qF4X_a3w==&c=goYtfvUszmnnFwdKNQt74kkZuOTs26nfMnFK3r1sAuKyM59-N64t-w==&ch=e45RoH9H6gml3yBy_DeZrATzRL5O-lT3zwmLGVfZ4V5OIZDtD7qqeg==) \-- WUGA
"It's an issue we've certainly seen in Athens and we've gotta make sure our local governments are enforcing their own rules and state rules."
---
| |
---
| EVENTS AND CAPITOL VISITORS
---
| It's been an exciting and busy past couple of weeks down at the Capitol.
I want to thank the many individuals and groups who have come to visit us. Last week, we had a local Oconee County Girl Scout Troop visit, as well as the Klein family from Athens, and Ned Butler and Darrell McWaters from Walton County.
---
| |
---
|
---
| |
---
| Last week, I joined the Barrow County Chamber for its annual gala in Braselton and stopped by a breakfast in Covington the next morning on the way back to the Gold Dome. This week, I enjoyed visiting with folks from Butts County, Newton County, and Henry County at the Capitol.
Wednesday marked the Georgia Chiefs of Police Day at the Capitol - I enjoyed seeing so many of our law enforcement leaders and thank them for the work they do every single day in our communities.
---
| |
---
|
---
| |
---
|
---
| |
---
| If there is ever an event in our community where you'd like for me to attend or speak, please reach out and let us know. I also invite you to join us at the Capitol one day this Session to see your legislature at work.
---
| |
---
| PAGE PROGRAM
---
| The Page Program at the Capitol gives students the opportunity to spend a day with us in the House and learn more about the work we do under the Gold Dome. So far this year, I've had three pages.
Brady Kratz was our first page of the year, and this past Thursday, Lucy and Ellie Denham paged. Thanks to these three outstanding students for coming to the Capitol and for their interest in learning more about state government!
If you know of a student who may be interested in paging, please reach out anytime.
---
| |
---
| |
---
| |
---
| WHAT'S NEXT?
---
| Over the next two weeks, we will complete legislative day 25 of 40. We are nearly half of the way through Session. March 6 is the next major deadline - Crossover Day, when a bill must be through the House or Senate to remain active this year. The major legislation of the Session will begin moving very quickly.
As always, we stand ready to help with any questions, comments, or concerns that you may have. Please reach out if I can ever be of assistance. Thank you for allowing me the honor to serve as your State Representative!
---

Hillary Clinton acknowledged at the Munich Security Conference Saturday that loose immigration policies in the U.S. and other Western countries **["went too far, it's been disruptive and destabilizing,](https://substack.com/redirect/1bf88cc8-9d1a-4b46-a68f-66995f06bc2f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and it needs to be fixed with secure borders -- also admitting that her husband Bill Clinton and Barack Obama deported far more people than Trump has.
"More people were deported under my husband and Barack Obama without killing American citizens and without putting children into detention camps then were in the first Trump term or in the first year of Trump's second term!!" Clinton bragged.
## [Watch her shocking blunder here: ](https://substack.com/redirect/1bf88cc8-9d1a-4b46-a68f-66995f06bc2f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

* **Why it matters:** Clinton pointed to deportation numbers to defend Democratic immigration records, noting "more people were deported under my husband and Barack Obama without killing American citizens and without putting children into detention camps." During the Clinton administration over 12 million were deported, and during the Obama years 5 million were deported across two terms -- compared to Trump's claimed 3 million in his second term, including 2.2 million "self-deportations."
* **The big picture:** Clinton has periodically warned about the political dangers of lax immigration, telling a 2018 audience that Europe needed "to get a handle on migration because that is what lit the flame," and reportedly pressing the Biden administration privately to tighten enforcement during New York City's 2023 migrant crisis. Notably, encounters at the U.S.-Mexico border are currently at their lowest level in more than five decades -- lower than during the Clinton, Obama, and first Trump administrations.

The U.S. and the interim Rodriguez government signed a massive energy pact in late January, with Venezuelan crude oil proceeds now flowing into U.S.-controlled accounts. Trump also used the Fort Bragg visit to warn troops that Democrats winning the midterms would result in the military being "stripped" and the base name being changed back to Fort Liberty.

* * *
# **Did Obama just admit aliens exist?**
Former President Barack Obama was **[forced to clarify his stance on extraterrestrial life](https://substack.com/redirect/37d95cb7-ecfe-4f5c-8e50-21881ba7414b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Sunday after a podcast clip went viral in which he told left-wing podcaster Brian Tyler Cohen "they're real, but I haven't seen them" when asked if aliens existed during a lightning round segment.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/26d6c6f1-88a9-41e0-8450-d79fff3aa6e9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* **What he said:** Obama took to Instagram to walk back the remarks, explaining that "statistically, the universe is so vast that the odds are good there's life out there," but that "the distances between solar systems are so great that the chances we've been visited by aliens is low, and I saw no evidence during my presidency that extraterrestrials have made contact with us." He also denied the existence of a secret alien facility, saying "they're not being kept in Area 51. There's no underground facility, unless there's this enormous conspiracy and they hid it from the president."
* **Why it matters:** The confusion stemmed partly from the podcast format itself -- host Brian Tyler Cohen failed to follow up on Obama's initial alien admission twice, instead moving on to questions about the pope, leaving the former president's comments open to interpretation. Obama said he "was trying to stick with the spirit of the speed round" before clarifying that his original answer was meant to reflect the statistical likelihood of life existing somewhere in the vast universe rather than confirmed extraterrestrial contact with Earth.

* * *
# **Taliban pledges "full support" to Iran in event of American military attack**
Afghan Taliban spokesman Zabihullah Mujahid declared Sunday in a Radio Iran interview that Afghanistan **[would"stand in solidarity and offer full support to their Iranian brethren"](https://substack.com/redirect/d299af1b-1b4a-4864-a91f-bed70eda0c1f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** if the U.S. attacks Iran, while also emphasizing the Taliban would prefer to see peaceful negotiations succeed over war between Washington and Tehran.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d299af1b-1b4a-4864-a91f-bed70eda0c1f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Why it matters:** The declaration comes as Iran and the Trump administration are engaged in preliminary nuclear talks through an Omani intermediary, following U.S. airstrikes in June 2025 on Iran's three major uranium enrichment sites at Natanz, Fordow, and Isfahan. Trump has warned of a "phase two" of strikes if negotiations fail, saying "we have to make a deal, otherwise it's going to be very traumatic" and pushing for an agreement "over the next month."

Friends,
Presidents’ Day is a moment to reflect on the leaders who have shaped our democracy—and the work still ahead to ensure it truly represents all of us.
We’ve made historic progress, from the founding of our nation to the election of President Barack Obama. We have come close, but one milestone still remains: the United States has never elected a woman president.
That’s why the work of building a strong, diverse leadership pipeline matters more than ever.
And it’s working.
In the 2024 cycle, Emerge alums won across the country—including 13 women elected to federal office . From Congresswomen Lucy McBath and Melanie Stansbury to Emilia Sykes, Yassamin Ansari, and more, Emerge women are stepping up and delivering for their communities.
In Oregon alone, four Emerge alums were elected to Congress —a powerful reminder that when we invest in women, we build lasting political power.
This is how change happens: not all at once, but election by election—candidate by candidate.
Emerge is opening doors, breaking barriers, and preparing Democratic women to lead at every level of government. And when women lead, our democracy is stronger, more inclusive, and more representative.
If we want to see the first woman president in our lifetime, we have to invest in the pipeline now.
Will you make a Presidents’ Day gift to help train the next generation of Democratic women leaders?

body:
Governing isn’t content

| | | | |
---
Peter, Public service isn’t a brand. It’s a responsibility. That’s not how the current office holder seems to view it. Lately, this Congressional seat has been used by its holder for headlines and political theater, chasing attention instead of doing the work. The loudest quote. The most extreme statement. The next viral moment. It may keep someone in the news, but it doesn’t help families here at home. [ ](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/Z2WJsZC2QywCZObIGloX0Q~~/AAUS1hA~/ALagJq8Iau7kTaYzWvvhIerFiGKtBta6iQSCHmnch9p3btlM3P0glDSZGa-2rJfmuWX-SgZ2Dh649_2lO68h9zIhu_a1EHINU0j2Fz-nKb10YQ-E-i2a5DQzv-ycOqKF7DNqiqxXmUN00cZ7DB_AVQr0IG7kmiTaWVRv781mG_8yeL55ONcee-lkNrm7Drj3H82pd0dFtahvF-4ai_5NLeBhqheu21tkB9Qo7_ndw6zZq434G-r-fIZwt3XgX4ng) That’s not why I ran for office. As mayor, I’ve learned that governing isn’t about ego. It’s about service. Elon Musk’s DOGE took millions of Americans’ private Social Security records and handed access to election deniers . Congress needs to make sure it never happens again.

They inspire us. And right now, we need more of them.

**I’ll be honest. It's hard to celebrate Presidents’ Day when the person in the Oval Office has abandoned every principle of real leadership.** Real leaders don't arrest journalists for doing their jobs — as we saw with Don Lemon. They don't call for nationalizing elections to consolidate power or weaponize federal agencies against their own citizens. Real leaders inspire us. They unite us. They make the choices that protect democracy and people, not dismantle it. Right now, we’re witnessing the exact opposite. But I've lived long enough to know that darkness has a way of revealing the light. And all across the country, real leaders are stepping up. Some are running for office to protect their communities from authoritarianism and the fossil fuel industry. Others are in the streets protesting ICE raids and defending their neighbors. And many more are speaking out, organizing, and refusing to stay silent while our rights are stripped away. **At JanePAC, we’ve helped elect more than 200 candidates across the country who embody that courageous spirit — leaders who won’t bow to Big Oil or Trump’s cruelty. And you can bet we’ll continue doing so in 2026 and beyond.** Which brings me to a simple but important question. As we head deeper into 2026, I want to know: **[What are you looking for in the leaders we elect? Is it courage? Accountability? The willingness to stand up when others look away? Tell me what matters most to you — because your answer matters to this movement. Your voice helps shape who we support and how we fight back.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/125502513/601991688/966682556?refcode=ea.783d5e94-500b-f111-832e-0022482a9733&ms=ea.783d5e94-500b-f111-832e-0022482a9733&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjc4M2Q1ZTk0LTUwMGItZjExMS04MzJlLTAwMjI0ODJhOTczMyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=oDZDyoi1HR72aMr59iuRMWN7XbRCbY9RKMaGsB3eSI8=&emci=cf28c704-1109-f111-832e-0022482a9733&emdi=783d5e94-500b-f111-832e-0022482a9733&ceid=4823105)** | [SHARE YOUR THOUGHTS →](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/125502520/601991724/966682556?refcode=ea.783d5e94-500b-f111-832e-0022482a9733&ms=ea.783d5e94-500b-f111-832e-0022482a9733&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjc4M2Q1ZTk0LTUwMGItZjExMS04MzJlLTAwMjI0ODJhOTczMyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=oDZDyoi1HR72aMr59iuRMWN7XbRCbY9RKMaGsB3eSI8=&emci=cf28c704-1109-f111-832e-0022482a9733&emdi=783d5e94-500b-f111-832e-0022482a9733&ceid=4823105)

name: Kirk Cameron
subject: Fight Back Against Hollywood's Agenda with Iggy and Mr. Kirk
body:
Today you have a very special chance to stop the Hollywood groomers who are turning our children and grandchildren against us and the Godly values we love.

| | | You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with "entertainment" that grooms children.
---
| |
---
| | Dear Friend in Faith,Please – for the sake of all our families – take it from me as someone who’s lived and worked in Hollywood my whole life... You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with “entertainment” that grooms children.You may remember shows with wholesome messages like Father Knows Best, Marcus Welby, M.D., and even Dennis the Menace.But today when children turn on the TV, they see a Drag Queen leading the Pride Parade on _Blue’s Clues_...
---
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zt2rikd24gs4k2kbidbp4osdl0ol0b42p5muu38o_rp22sh2s8i6epr4c9jm6pb4c5h2bs)
---
| | Or Sesame Street using YOUR tax-dollars to normalize same-sex parents and men in dresses.And the result is an upside-down world where children lecture YOU about what you can and cannot say... ...and they try to “educate” YOU about your “old-fashioned” and “mean” ideas.Today you have a very special chance to stop the Hollywood groomers who are turning our children and grandchildren against us and the Godly values we love. **[Today, I’m inviting you to be a Founding Supporter of the very first children’s television show that actively fights back against the groomers in Hollywood AND reinforces the traditional biblical values that made America great.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z7i3ddejk97fnkgkmukga3enlk296824p66unkog_rp22sh2s8i6epr4c9jm6pb4c5h2bs)** Introducing: _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_.I’m making this ground-breaking live-action television show with the great folks at **Brave Books**.If you’ve seen me and **Brave Books** on _Fox News_ , you know we’ve already countered those awful “Drag Queen Story Hours” the Left has been pushing on children in our taxpayer funded libraries. Thanks to support from parents, grandparents, and concerned citizens just like you, we started hosting Godly and patriotic “Story Hours” of our own.And now, THOUSANDS of children and parents can gather to pledge allegiance to our flag, read wholesome books, and pray together in their libraries.It’s encouraging to see we can win when we fight back! Now we’re working to have that same impact in television.
---
>> Imagine a children's show that leaves your child or grandchild with a greater sense of right and wrong and an understanding of truth.Courage, honesty, discernment, forgiveness, empathy, all taught through a biblical and traditional lens. >> Imagine a children's show that brings families together instead of driving them apart.>> Now imagine YOU are the one who makes that show possible. Because we can’t beat the Hollywood groomers without your help as a **Founding Supporter**.
---
The great news is that we’ve already completed and released the first ten character-building episodes of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_! We premiered it recently to a small group of children and parents and I wish you could have seen the smiles on those innocent little faces.And I wish you could have experienced _the parents_ watching their children absorb the beautiful Gospel messages.It was quite a moment for everyone – including folks just like you – who worked so hard to get us that far. But now **Brave Books** has an urgent two-fold problem that I hope you can help with.
---
_**#1. Brave Books needs to launch a massive advertising blitz to get around the groomers on the Left.**_
---
You see, we’ve made the first five episodes of Season 1 of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ available absolutely FREE. That’s the best way we can reach MILLIONS of families with our Gospel-inspired messaging.But no one will see it if we can’t get the word out. And the Left will try to bury _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ at every turn. The price tag for an advertising blitz of this magnitude is $250,000 – and with the recent launch, we need to raise the funds immediately.
---
_**#2. We must complete Season 2 to keep our momentum going and that cost is $250,000 for post production.**_
---
I know that’s a lot of money but it’s actually a fraction of what it would cost if we made our show with a major Hollywood studio. And obviously, we won’t work through Hollywood.Hollywood has done quite enough already to destroy American culture and hijack our children.We parents, grandparents, and concerned citizens must take over to rebuild a thriving, healthy, GOOD and GODLY culture. **[That’s why I’m asking you to please contribute $35, $50, $250, $500, $2,500 or more to help us reach our fundraising goal of $250,000 for advertising and $250,000 for Season 2.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zalmij8qh0bjnedfn9vh5vu1r3a97jbdltl0iqb0_rp22sh2s8i6epr4c9jm6pb4c5h2bs) ** As our special “Thank You” for becoming a **Founding Supporter** at the $50 level, we’ll send you all ten episodes of Season 1 of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ FREE on DVD.This exclusive _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ DVD is only offered to **Founding Supporters**. It won’t be available for sale anywhere. So with **[**your gift of $50**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zr2jj2eaijp5n28kann5qeq1ngutbomapg69n9f8_rp22sh2s8i6epr4c9jm6pb4c5h2bs)** , you’ll be part of a small select group of people who own our wholesome TV show on DVD. You’ll have it ready to watch with the children in your life. Or you can drop your DVD by your local school, church, mission, or even leave it in the waiting room at your doctor’s office. So many children have no way of hearing God’s message in their lives. Your random act of kindness may change a child’s life. **[So please – whether you can send $50, $5,000, $25,000, or anything higher or lower, please respond quickly and know that gifts of EVERY size are needed and greatly appreciated.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zbkvuqgesjbf1iiearok2fo76tn1sdadhvn41u78_rp22sh2s8i6epr4c9jm6pb4c5h2bs)** There’s no time to waste. Hollywood groomers have destroyed America’s Godly culture. But today we rebuild from the ashes.And it starts by ensuring the most innocent among us are filled with faith and family – not filth.Thank you for being a part of history by becoming a **Founding Supporter** of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_.
---
Sincerely,

Hollywood elites buying this race.

I know you hear this every election year, but 2026 will define our country in a big way.
What's different this time around is that the damage politicians and pundits had been warning about is already here.
Trump is tearing off the guardrails of our Democracy. We've seen healthcare and food assistance gutted. Prices are rising on everything because of Trump's tariffs, and his cronies keep sticking to them anyway.
ICE is literally killing American citizens in broad daylight. The National Guard has been deployed to Democrat-led cities.
Trump's regime change operation in Venezuela – which he executed without Congressional approval – has set a dangerous precedent and added to this era of uncertainty we're all suffering through.

Peter, This Presidents Day, we’re not celebrating. We’re enraged and saddened by a president who has spent his second term working to undermine our democracy. Here in Georgia, we felt those attacks firsthand. After the 2020 election, Donald Trump didn’t just lie — he launched a brazen, sustained assault on our freedom to vote. He pressured our state officials to “find” votes. He tried to bully and intimidate our election workers. And he has supported laws designed to make it harder for Georgians — especially Black Georgians — to cast a ballot. These are attempts to silence us. To strip us of our voice. To overturn an election because he didn’t like the results. We can’t afford to be silent. We can’t afford to be complacent. We have to organize, fight back, and protect our rights. I don't know about you, but I've been finding it increasingly difficult to concentrate lately. There I'll be, trying to work, or read, or eat dinner, when the intrusive thought returns: For decades, many of the wealthiest men and [women](https://substack.com/redirect/9c518f17-18c1-42b3-b897-d2964aefb6db?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in the world actively participated in the trafficking and rape of children; the powers that be knew what was happening; nobody was held accountable.
Even today, few of Epstein's enablers are facing consequences--[in this country, at least](https://substack.com/redirect/599a21b2-f76a-4ccd-a6ec-4ba055c5fd1a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). America's legal system insists on punishing regular people harshly for even the most minor crimes--or now for the non-crime of simply being an immigrant, or just being someone who _looks_ like an immigrant to one of Trump's Gestapo thugs. But the rich and powerful spent year after year manifesting nightmares straight out of conspiracy theories, and yet they've faced absolutely zero consequences for these depravities. Trump's DOJ continues redacting the names of abusers. His administration transferred Ghislaine Maxwell to a cushy minimum security prison where she is [reportedly](https://substack.com/redirect/43efcde1-cf91-4a47-a297-e486279ab965?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) waited on hand and foot by prison officials. It looks increasingly likely that the president will grant this convicted teen sex trafficker [clemency](https://substack.com/redirect/690ec6a3-0137-422c-9b5e-c32866abbdad?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in exchange for her publicly testifying that Trump--whose name is apparently referenced over [one million times](https://substack.com/redirect/59611a96-3590-4c0b-91e7-0dac86e10df5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in the Epstein files--was not involved in her demonic enterprise. And Republicans in Congress--all but the smallest handful of dissidents, practically all of whom are being driven out of politics for their apostasy--are doing everything they can to protect these monsters.
This story is horrifying. But it's also clarifying. The primary purpose of the GOP has been laid bare: to shield the wealthy and well-connected from facing justice for their crimes.
Thanks for reading! Subscribe here.
[Subscribed](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9hYXJvbnJlZ3VuYmVyZy5zdWJzdGFjay5jb20vYWNjb3VudCIsInAiOjE4Nzg1NjM0MCwicyI6NDk4MTE3MCwiZiI6dHJ1ZSwidSI6OTA1MDExOTIsImlhdCI6MTc3MTI2MzMyOCwiZXhwIjoyMDg2ODM5MzI4LCJpc3MiOiJwdWItMCIsInN1YiI6ImxpbmstcmVkaXJlY3QifQ.c-AwmMUIUmHf4-_qvYy7yI0ruylQ8r0DUeDh0fMGDjs?)
In fact, elite impunity seems to be the common thread in practically all the significant policy fights Republicans have picked over the last year. It's apparent, of course, in every decision of Trump's Department of Justice. Throwing a sandwich at someone in uniform? Republicans will move heaven and earth to take you down. But engaging in blatantly criminal bribery? The administration has explicitly [announced](https://substack.com/redirect/11031045-4716-479b-903f-e9b328147420?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) it won't prosecute corporations for these crimes, or really for [any crimes](https://substack.com/redirect/00479fb1-3761-4252-80d3-303bedde53ac?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) at all.
Elite impunity clearly defines the GOP's positions on public health. Despite the supposed influence of the Make America Healthy Again movement on the GOP, Republicans have been working to [shield pesticide makers](https://substack.com/redirect/f92d0bcd-4691-435f-8382-001cbaf435fe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) from liability for failing to warn consumers that their products would cause cancer. Monsanto, which faces 100,000 lawsuits related to its Roundup weedkiller, went crying to the GOP for protection, and as always, Republicans responded. Though Democrats were able to [remove](https://substack.com/redirect/13845fa7-b34d-4599-ad16-9857e9d8b48e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the GOP's pesticide liability waiver from a congressional appropriations bill in January, the Trump administration has taken up the cause and is [asking](https://substack.com/redirect/964fdc7b-70a4-414f-aad5-43b0066d612e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the Supreme Court to step in and shield these companies from accountability for the decades they spent poisoning Americans.
This dynamic is also apparent in the GOP's slavish devotion to AI billionaires. The [class divide](https://substack.com/redirect/ed336216-bfea-48b5-8e86-27700a53cdc5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on this topic is sharp--regular Americans are increasingly [concerned](https://substack.com/redirect/651b4a98-d077-4e2a-ab25-f9e8ddddd592?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) about the potentially devastating impact of AI on their jobs and their kids' economic prospects, and they sure as hell don't want parasitic AI data centers raising their electricity prices and fouling their water. But the Epstein class loves this plutocracy-enriching technology, so the GOP jumped into action. Your community wants to hold AI billionaires accountable for the harmful effects--mass unemployment, suicide, cognitive decline, climate breakdown--of their products? Not while the party of elite impunity is in charge. Twice last year, Republicans in Congress tried to pass a law [preventing](https://substack.com/redirect/ea5dabe1-122f-4963-b63c-f8a007077af2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) state and local regulation of AI. Democrats were able to defeat both efforts, but in December Trump signed an [executive order](https://substack.com/redirect/cb5c4507-cb5c-4390-80e0-2b27d7dcb64f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to bypass Congress by, among other measures, directing his government to mount legal challenges to state AI laws and withhold federal funds from jurisdictions that are regulating AI.
Then there's climate change. Millions of voters are already feeling the pain of skyrocketing home insurance rates driven by increased climate risks, and millions more are confronted each year with the staggering costs of climate disaster recovery, without any help from the corporations that created and profited from this crisis. So communities across the country have been pursuing state legislation and litigation to make fossil fuel companies pay for the damages they caused--the homes swallowed by the sea, businesses wiped off the map by inland flooding, communities destroyed by wildfires, lethal heat waves, horrific droughts, and other catastrophes. In response, Big Oil has been [begging](https://substack.com/redirect/d0180071-f11d-4648-83c0-2b5599b449f6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for a get-out-of-jail-free card, with the American Petroleum Institute explicitly [naming](https://substack.com/redirect/fd938e85-001d-4363-b5cf-13f72ead8186?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Big Oil immunity one of its top priorities in 2026. Naturally, Republicans have answered the call, with the administration filing multiple legally unhinged lawsuits to try to stop states from pursuing accountability litigation, and Congressional Republicans recently announcing that they are [crafting legislation](https://substack.com/redirect/410b8150-0140-4bc6-9f63-a66415712c1b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to block communities from having their day in court.
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=4981170&post_id=187856340&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTg3ODU2MzQwLCJpYXQiOjE3NzEyNjMzMjgsImV4cCI6MTc3Mzg1NTMyOCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTQ5ODExNzAiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.v4Yn6YNLzeJB0wmyam6tEuwJR07xggOT5o68kbzX28w)
On issue after issue, the GOP has gone to the mat to shield the most powerful and wealthy individuals and entities from having to face consequences for their misdeeds. Whether they're protecting pedophiles, immunizing Big Ag, defending Big Tech, or shielding Big Oil, Republicans have demonstrated that theirs is the party of elite impunity. Surely Democrats should be making this a central part of their messaging this year.
Affordability--the Democratic establishment's main talking point in 2026--is important: voters are sick and tired of seeing the cost of living continue to rise under Republican rule. But they're also sick and tired of seeing America's two-tiered legal system treat the most disgusting and avaricious people in the world like they're above the law. Democrats need to walk and chew gum at the same time here.
Because I don't think I'm the only one who's been having trouble concentrating lately. There's a rage building in this country against those who continue insisting on one set of rules for you and me and another for the rich and powerful. Americans are ready to tear down that system of elite impunity. Let's make sure they vote out its party, too.

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. Peter, I love our Constitution. That’s why I’ve sworn an oath to protect and defend it many times throughout my life, including as an intelligence officer in the United States Navy Reserve, as a Deputy Assistant Attorney General, and now as New Hampshire’s Congresswoman. **This is a moment for moral clarity and legal clarity in America.** That’s why, together with five other Members of Congress who also served in our military and intelligence community, I released a video that clearly and simply states a cornerstone principle of American law: that members of our military have a duty to follow legal orders and legal orders only. In response, President Trump became unglued. He incited violence against me. He called for me to be investigated. He said I should be arrested. He even suggested I should be “hanged” simply for doing my job and upholding my oath to our Constitution. Former _Fox News_ host Jeanine Pirro, now Trump’s go-to U.S. Attorney, is following through on these threats. Last week, news broke that they tried and failed to indict me for restating federal law and honoring our Constitution. This outrageous abuse of power is just the beginning. In the face of these threats, I have kept my head held high and stood up for what is right: We the People and our Constitution. body:
[https://d15k2d11r6t6rl.cloudfront.net/public/users/Integrators/04eaa6b2-88f4-43b4-b978-7bb0708f5838/617370535A5771373630636B76786346755272494B6376314E4C57646366366C5575352B4C6339657071684B6F454D51395479643654426241786B6A6454752B/editor_images/Screen%20Shot%202026-01-27%20at%2011.11.49%20AM.png]
My name is Alex Vindman, and I wanted you to hear directly from me: I am running for the United States Senate in Florida.
I’ll explain more about why I chose to run, but if you already know the stakes of this race — and are fired up to defeat Donald Trump’s top ally in the Senate — then please become a Founding Donor by splitting a donation between my campaign and Resist Reclaim Rebuild:
BECOME A FOUNDING DONOR TO MY CAMPAIGN TODAY! >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-vindman]
I swore an oath to protect this country when I joined the U.S. Army more than two decades ago.
In 2019, I honored that oath by blowing the whistle on Donald Trump’s corrupt phone call with Ukraine, an act that led to Trump’s first impeachment and ultimately cost me my military career.
People told me to keep my head down. But my family came here as refugees to escape tyranny. I sure as hell wasn’t going to bow down to a wannabe tyrant.
This president unleashed a reign of terror and retribution, not just against me and my family, but against all of us.
Today, our country is in chaos. We are entering a dark chapter of American history, one that echoes early stages of authoritarian power consolidation seen elsewhere.
Thug militias attacking citizens. Tariffs pushing prices sky-high. Healthcare premiums through the roof. While all of this is happening, my opponent refuses to put the interests of the American people before her own self-interest.
Ashley Moody screwed Florida homeowners by caving to the big insurance companies, supported this administration that gutted disaster help for communities trying to rebuild, and had over a million dollars in her corporate stock traded last year while she had access to insider information only Congress gets.
They put Ashley Moody in the Senate to be a ‘yes’ vote for Trump and the billionaires. She’s not Florida’s senator. She’s theirs.
We need someone who isn’t afraid to put a check on an outlaw president, to defend our democracy, and to make sure that every American has a fair chance at prosperity.
That is why I am running for Senate, and why I am humbly asking you:
Will you split a donation of any amount between my Senate campaign in Florida and Resist Reclaim Rebuild before midnight? Your donations add up quickly when everyone is chipping in. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-vindman]
CHIP IN TODAY TO HELP DEMS FLIP THE SENATE! >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-vindman]
The billionaires and special interests will throw everything they’ve got to try and stop us. But in the infantry, we didn’t back down from a fight — we went towards it. Join me.
Thank you.

body:
"Professor Bohannan... Can they actually do that? Doesn't that violate the precedent we just studied?"

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/125513833/602026284/-975735282?refcode=em_logoheader&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjIyOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0OWM3MDQ5NC02MzBiLWYxMTEtODMyZS0wMDIyNDgyYTk3MzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=pln_U9KnDCWc48TfM3xWfji4gqW2JVRNJp5MIBmcWZk=)

Peter,

In the past, when I taught Constitutional Law, my students used to complain that it was _really, really boring._ And honestly, I can see why they felt that way — it was a whole semester of reading _really old_ Supreme Court opinions. **It wasn't exactly edge-of-your-seat stuff, but that was the whole point. The Constitution is _supposed_ to be a steady foundation we can all rely on.**

Lately, more and more students come up to me holding up the latest headline and asking, _"Professor Bohannan... Can they actually do that? Doesn't that violate the precedent we just studied?"_

I can't fully describe what it feels like, as a professor, to watch future lawyers realize in real time that the guardrails of our democracy are being tested, and that the institutions we have all taken for granted might not be there for them and future generations.

What we are witnessing right now is an administration that seems hell-bent on pushing every boundary on the separation of powers and the rule of law. And instead of acting as a barrier, Mariannette Miller-Meeks is only too willing to stand by and do whatever her party bosses tell her to do. That is not how our system is supposed to work. **Congress was designed to be a check, not a spectator.**

I didn't grow up dreaming of running for office, but I also never imagined I would watch leaders treat our Constitution as optional — or worse, as an obstacle. _If Mariannette Miller-Meeks won't take her role in office seriously, then I will._ **I'm running because I believe the Constitution still means something, and I am more than ready to be a voice for it and for the rights it guarantees every one of us.**

**[But I can't get there alone. If you're ready for someone who will stand up for the Constitution instead of looking for ways around it, I hope you'll chip in today and help power this campaign>>](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/125513834/602026285/-2011951990?refcode=em26_260216_conlaw_fnd_gq_act___CB_ettx&utm_campaign=em26_260216_conlaw_fnd_gq_act___CB_ettx&utm_medium=email&refcode2=49c70494-630b-f111-832e-0022482a9733&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjIyOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0OWM3MDQ5NC02MzBiLWYxMTEtODMyZS0wMDIyNDgyYTk3MzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=pln_U9KnDCWc48TfM3xWfji4gqW2JVRNJp5MIBmcWZk=)**

Thank you,
