body:
President's Day is meant to remind us that the office of the presidency should lift our country up and model the values we expect in public life.

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/125514009/602026954/-1481197821?amount=10&refcode=02.16.26_og_fr_presidentsday&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDg5NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5MjFkNmU0Ny02NDBiLWYxMTEtODMyZS0wMDIyNDgyYTk3MzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=vya9x1eEgpUPBa6OEDK5QcJPgjZRWM093ZaQDm2yQM8=) Hi friend, Today, on President’s Day, I am taking a moment to reflect on leadership and what separates good leaders from bad ones:
* Bad: Leaders using American taxpayers to line their own pockets.
* Bad: Leaders repealing environmental protections so big corporations can freely pollute our air, water, and environment.
* Bad: Leaders that pass laws that make it harder for Americans to vote.
* Bad: Leaders that sell the American people out time and time again for their own personal gain.
* **Good: Leaders that stand up to corruption and greed to fight for us. **

Day after day, this leadership lines their own pockets at the cost of the American people. Republicans think that by pushing an extreme political agenda, they can divert our attention from the damage they are doing to us, our families, and our communities. **But they are wrong, and the American people are paying attention. ** I do my best to be a good leader every day. As a former public school teacher, I helped create Preschool Promise so kids get a strong start. In Congress I’ve worked across the aisle to lower prescription drug costs and secure millions in local investments that deliver real, practical results for Ohio families. Right now, the choice in 2026 is clear. We can tolerate politics that puts power and corruption first, or we can elect people who will stand up, call out bad actors, and deliver for our communities. That is the team I am building — grounded in our neighborhoods, refusing corporate PAC money, and focused on practical solutions that make life better here at home. [**Will you stand with me today and help keep this fight going?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/125514010/602026955/-1481197821?amount=10&refcode=02.16.26_og_fr_presidentsday&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDg5NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5MjFkNmU0Ny02NDBiLWYxMTEtODMyZS0wMDIyNDgyYTk3MzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=vya9x1eEgpUPBa6OEDK5QcJPgjZRWM093ZaQDm2yQM8=) | If you've stored your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will process now.

# **PRESIDENT’S DAY MESSAGE**
****

**FROM PRESIDENT TRUMP:**
As we celebrate President’s Day, I wanted to reach out and thank you for the incredible role you play in defending our great responsibility to this nation.
President’s Day is a time to honor the bold leaders who built this country but more importantly, it’s a day to honor YOU, the American people.
You are the heartbeat of this Republic, and your devotion to our values — faith, family, freedom — is what truly makes America Great.
Because of your unwavering support, we are back in the White House, standing stronger than ever, YES, AMERICA IS BACK, and delivering on the promises we made to the American people.
**[As a special token of my appreciation this President’s Day, I have a commemorative gift I want to send directly to my supporters.>](https://link.win.donaldjtrump.)**

[CLAIM TRUMP FLAG PIN](https://link.win.donaldjtrump.)
Please accept this as my way of saying thank you for standing by me through every battle. We are making history together every single day.
**_[I would deeply appreciate it too if you chipped in any amount: whether it’s SMALL or very GENEROUS as we’re in a critical midterm year.>](https://link.win.donaldjtrump.)_**
With faith in God and an unbreakable love for this land, we will never stop fighting for the America we love.
God bless you and your family, and may God bless the United States of America.
\- President Donald J. Trump

| | **How to Sign a Petition:**
Each person who signs a petition must personally insert the following information about himself or herself: 1) Signature 2) Printed name as it appears on their voter registration card 3) Address of Residence, including street and number, and the city/township/borough (may differ from the mailing address) 4) The Date in which he or she signed the nomination petition
**Where to Get Signatures?**
If you think outside the box, anyone can get at least 25 signatures from people you interact regularly with. Besides standing outside of the local Wal-Mart or grocery store, here are some suggestions on where you can find people to sign petitions:
* Family Members that are registered Republicans in PA-08
* Neighbors
* Co-workers
* Friends from Church
* Public Places
* Rotary and other professional clubs
* Junior League
* Local Republican Committee meetings and events
* Republican Clubs
* Children’s sports games

**Where to get your Petition Packet**
* [**Email Frank**](mailto:frank@robforpa.com?subject=Need%20Petitions&body=) to print it out yourself
* Stop by one of the County GOP Offices
* Call Frank to coordinate a time for drop-off at (570) 793-1487

# California turns to Bahamas fuel amid gasoline crunch they caused
Gasoline-starved California[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/8c7d8dca-6f42-4acd-a5bf-f588ea028c65?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[imported a record volume of fuel in November,](https://substack.com/redirect/8c7d8dca-6f42-4acd-a5bf-f588ea028c65?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** with over 40% routed circuitously through the Bahamas from US Gulf Coast supplies, as refinery closures shrink in-state production and drive up already high pump prices for drivers.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8c7d8dca-6f42-4acd-a5bf-f588ea028c65?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Record Import Surge** : November saw unprecedented gasoline imports to California, marking the highest levels since at least 2016 due to shrinking local refining capacity.
* **Bahamas Routing Loophole** : US gasoline travels thousands of extra miles via the Bahamas to bypass costly Jones Act shipping requirements, exploiting a workaround in the century-old maritime law.
* **Refinery Closures Accelerate** : Phillips 66 shuttered its Los Angeles facility in October, with Valero's Northern California refinery set to close this spring, eliminating significant production.
* **Price Hike Implications** : The supply squeeze and added transport costs could boost gasoline prices by 5 to 15 cents per gallon on average, intensifying burdens on California consumers.

# Chevron refinery surges on Venezuelan crude post-Maduro capture
Chevron's Pascagoula refinery in Mississippi has begun **[processing its first shipment of heavy Venezuelan crude](https://substack.com/redirect/5d77cbe8-e66d-4052-9796-90765bbaefba?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** since the U.S. capture of Nicolas Maduro last month, turning tar-like oil into fuel for American consumers and signaling renewed sanctioned operations that could lower costs and boost efficiency.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5d77cbe8-e66d-4052-9796-90765bbaefba?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Pascagoula processes daily** : The flagship Gulf Coast facility currently handles 50,000 barrels per day of Venezuelan crude out of its 300,000-barrel total capacity, leveraging direct harbor access for efficient heavy sour crude deliveries.
* **Chevron expands production** : Company output in Venezuela has grown five-fold from 50,000 to 250,000 barrels per day, with potential for another 50% increase in the next 18-24 months under renewed authorizations.
* **Executive highlights benefits** : Downstream president Andy Walz notes cheaper, closer oil improves refinery design efficiency and drives down costs for U.S. consumers while aiding Venezuelan recovery.
* **Long-term U.S. presence** : CEO Mike Wirth emphasizes Chevron's century-long role in Venezuela, including debt repayment advantages over competitors who exited, positioning the company for sustained growth.

# Trump wants to forces Big Tech to pay for their skyrocketing power costs
President Trump's trade adviser Peter Navarro warned Sunday that the administration may force AI data center builders like Meta to **[fully"internalize" their massive electricity, water, and grid costs,](https://substack.com/redirect/9ec7bafd-9adb-4577-9151-b47a0172ca68?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** shielding consumers from soaring utility bills amid grid strain and affordability concerns ahead of the 2026 midterms.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/9ec7bafd-9adb-4577-9151-b47a0172ca68?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Grid Strain Escalates:** Data centers powering AI have overloaded the U.S. electricity grid, driving a 6.9% year-over-year spike in electricity prices in 2025 with no relief in sight.
* **Consumer Bills Surge:** Rising utility and water costs from data centers fuel voter frustration, contributing to economic souring and Trump's underwater polling on affordability issues.
* **Tech Cost Shifting:** The White House pushes deals requiring companies like Microsoft to cover new power plants and infrastructure, preventing pass-through expenses to households.
* **Policy Actions Advance:** January pact with states urges PJM Interconnection to mandate tech-funded generation capacity, while negotiations target Meta and other giants for full cost absorption.

# AI hunger sparks massive memory chip crisis
Explosive AI data center demand is **[triggering a severe global shortage of DRAM](https://substack.com/redirect/6a7a6b5c-3430-4876-8648-ac735f3791a8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/6a7a6b5c-3430-4876-8648-ac735f3791a8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)memory chips, constraining production at Tesla, Apple, and others while driving dramatic price surges--including one type jumping 75% in a month--and threatening higher costs for consumer devices from smartphones to laptops.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6a7a6b5c-3430-4876-8648-ac735f3791a8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Unprecedented Shortage Hits:** Major firms like Tesla and Apple report DRAM constraints since early 2026, forcing production limits and margin pressure on iPhones.
* **AI Giants Dominate Supply:** Alphabet and OpenAI devour memory via massive Nvidia AI accelerator purchases, starving consumer electronics makers amid data center buildouts.
* **Prices Soar Parabolically:** One DRAM type rose 75% from December to January, with daily retailer hikes and "RAMmageddon" warnings from industry insiders.
* **Extreme Warnings Issued:** Tesla's Elon Musk plans to build its own, while Lam Research CEO predicts demand will overwhelm all other sources through decade's end.

# OpenClaw founder Steinberger joins OpenAI
OpenAI has recruited Peter Steinberger, the creator of the viral open-source AI agent OpenClaw, **[to lead development of next-generation personal agents,](https://substack.com/redirect/7a5f4015-7963-4a92-83d8-4a79194346ca?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** with the project transitioning to an OpenAI-supported foundation while remaining open source, CEO Sam Altman announced Sunday.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7a5f4015-7963-4a92-83d8-4a79194346ca?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Viral Rise Explodes:** OpenClaw, formerly Clawdbot and Moltbot, launched in November and quickly amassed over 100,000 GitHub stars plus 2 million weekly visitors as a task-handling AI assistant.
* **Security Concerns Surface:** China's industry ministry issued warnings that improperly configured OpenClaw could expose users to cyberattacks and data breaches due to its powerful capabilities.
* **Steinberger 's Motivation Revealed:** The founder emphasized preserving OpenClaw's open-source status and chose OpenAI as the ideal partner to scale his vision of accessible AI agents globally.
* **Multi-Agent Future Hinted:** Altman praised Steinberger's ideas on agent interactions, predicting multi-agent systems will become core to OpenAI's offerings and drive personal AI advancements.

# Warner Bros eyes Paramount's latest offer with renewed interest
Warner Bros. Discovery's board is **[weighing whether to reopen sale talks](https://substack.com/redirect/c9da5e85-06da-4e0f-b255-d8a1442f7158?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** with Paramount Skydance after its rival submitted an amended offer addressing key concerns, potentially sparking a renewed bidding war with Netflix amid the company's existing $83 billion agreement.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c9da5e85-06da-4e0f-b255-d8a1442f7158?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Board Deliberates Options:** Warner Bros. Discovery directors are actively discussing if Paramount's latest proposal could lead to a superior deal or force Netflix to improve its bid.
* **Paramount Sweetens Terms:** The amended offer includes covering a $2.8 billion Netflix breakup fee, backstopping debt refinancing, and adding compensation if the deal delays past 2026.
* **Binding Netflix Pact Remains:** Warner Bros. Discovery holds a firm agreement with Netflix but contract terms allow pursuit of potentially better offers from Paramount.
* **Bidding War Potential Looms:** Reopening negotiations could ignite competition between Paramount's $108 billion hostile bid and Netflix's all-cash proposal for studios and streaming assets.

Peter —
We need to make some important budget decisions this afternoon.
Early voting starts tomorrow, so we need to treat every day like Election Day — running at full speed and reaching as many voters as we can.
You can feel the momentum on our side. We see it on the ground with the massive turnout at James’ events, thousands of volunteers knocking doors all across Texas, grassroots organizations coalescing our campaign, and nearly every major newspaper in Texas endorsing James.

body:
[Barlow Logo](https://barlowforwyo.com/)

Welcome to the Barlow for Wyoming Newsletter. Your hub for latest news, inf=
ormation and upcoming events.

=E2=80=8A

Stem Cell Freedom, Public Lands Protection, and a Town Hall Tour!

Hi friends,=C2=A0 Last week was a full week at the Capitol, and I=E2=80=99m=
grateful for the work getting done. We=E2=80=99ve had movement on the Stem=
Cell Freedom Act, continued work on the Roadside Safety =E2=80=9CMove Over=
=E2=80=9D bill, and strong bipartisan support for a Senate Joint Resolution=
to protect public lands and keep decisions local, with 38 Legislators sign=
ing on, along with me at introduction. These issues may look different, but=
they all come back to the same thing for me: respecting Wyoming people, pr=
otecting safety and access, and keeping decisions grounded here at home.
=C2=A0
During the session, I get to see lots of our citizens who have come to Chey=
enne to advocate for bills, learn more about the process, or gather with th=
eir associations. I was lucky to see many I knew and met some new folks.
=C2=A0
On the way home this past weekend, I joined JD Williams for his legislative=
town halls in Torrington, Lusk, and Newcastle. These visits matter to me, =
and I am always glad to hear what's exciting or worrisome for Wyomingites.
.=C2=A0
I'd like to briefly acknowledge the issue raised this week regarding the di=
stribution of donor checks on the House floor=E2=80=94integrity matters. Th=
e Legislature only works if the public can trust the institution and the pe=
ople serving in it. The Senate will clarify our rules to make it clear that=
these actions are not only unacceptable but also not allowed; the House wi=
ll move forward with a transparent investigative committee; and other inves=
tigations are underway. Public confidence in our institutions has to come f=
irst.
=C2=A0
I am focused with my Senate colleagues on working hard to bring forth a bud=
get we can all live with and add some meaningful bills along the way.
=C2=A0
If you're at the session, I hope to see you!=C2=A0
=C2=A0
=C2=A0- Eric=C2=A0

=C2=A0

Barlow Introduces Joint Resolution to Protect Public Lands and Keep Decisio=
ns Local
=C2=A0
Senator Eric Barlow today introduced a joint resolution reaffirming Wyoming=
=E2=80=99s commitment to keeping public lands protected, accessible, and ma=
naged through locally driven, multiple-use frameworks that reflect Wyoming=
=E2=80=99s heritage, economy, and way of life.
=C2=A0
The resolution opposes broad or indiscriminate sales of federal public land=
s and calls for meaningful involvement of state and local governments, coun=
ties, and affected communities in any decisions related to land management,=
exchanges, or disposal.

=E2=80=9CPublic lands are part of who we are as Wyoming people,=E2=80=9D Ba=
rlow said. =E2=80=9CThey support our economy, our communities, our traditio=
ns, and our ability to work, hunt, fish, graze, recreate, and pass these op=
portunities on to the next generation. Decisions about these lands shouldn=
=E2=80=99t be made in a vacuum by outside interests and Washington, D.C., e=
specially without real input from the state of Wyoming and our local govern=
ments and communities who live with those decisions every day.=E2=80=9D
=C2=A0
Wyoming residents access public lands at a higher rate than any other state=
, with approximately 91 percent of the population using federal lands for w=
ork, recreation, or subsistence. Natural resource industries tied to public=
lands contribute more than $11 billion annually to Wyoming=E2=80=99s econo=
my and support a significant portion of the state=E2=80=99s workforce, whil=
e agriculture and grazing remain foundational to rural communities.=C2=A0
=C2=A0
The resolution emphasizes Wyoming=E2=80=99s long-standing multiple-use appr=
oach, recognizing that responsible resource development, recreation, agricu=
lture, conservation, and wildlife management are not competing interests bu=
t complementary ones when guided by local knowledge and collaboration.
=C2=A0
Barlow noted that existing federal laws already provide pathways for land e=
xchanges or limited disposals when a clear public benefit exists, but said =
those processes must be efficient, transparent, and rooted in local input r=
ather than imposed from outside Wyoming.
=C2=A0
=E2=80=9CWhen changes are needed, Wyoming has shown we can work through the=
m the right way; =C2=A0with landowners, counties, industry, recreationists,=
and conservation interests at the table,=E2=80=9D Barlow said. =E2=80=9CWh=
at doesn=E2=80=99t work is top-down decision-making that dictates for Wyomi=
ng what is in our best interest and shifts long-term costs and management f=
or access, wildfire response, and infrastructure onto local communities wit=
hout their consent.=E2=80=9D
=C2=A0
The resolution also reaffirms Wyoming=E2=80=99s firearms heritage and state=
constitutional protections for hunting, fishing, and trapping, and highlig=
hts the role public lands play in supporting youth programs, outdoor tradit=
ions, and a thriving recreation and tourism economy.
=C2=A0
=E2=80=9C=E2=80=9CPublic lands are America=E2=80=99s best idea and most pre=
cious resource. In Wyoming, we use the land, we steward the land, and we wo=
rk hard to teach our children to responsibly do the same,=E2=80=9D Barlow s=
aid.
=C2=A0
There is never a good time to sell off federal lands in Wyoming without tal=
king to the ones who love it most, the people of Wyoming.=E2=80=9D=C2=A0

regular regulatory system,=E2=80=9D Barlow said.

ch will arrive for distribution this spring.

itional donation to keep the sign printer moving? Click the link below!=C2=

On The Trail

TORRINGTON, LUSK, and NEWCASTLE=C2=A0
=C2=A0
After a quick stop at the Bread Doctor in Torrington for a Valentine for Ke=
lly, we visited Torrington, Lusk, and Newcastle for town hall events over t=
he weekend, with JD Williams. The conversations centered on the necessity t=
o maintain local control in both our communities and state, and I couldn=E2=
=80=99t agree more.=C2=A0
=C2=A0
We don=E2=80=99t need D.C. driving Wyoming decisions, and we don=E2=80=99t =
need Cheyenne to feel like D.C. Wyoming can seem like less costly stomping =
grounds for the groups trying to infiltrate, and we need to keep them out.
=C2=A0
It was time well spent, hearing from folks about their hopes and concerns f=
or Wyoming, especially during this short budget session. Thank you to all w=
ho were able to attend.

e across our state.

These visits matter to me, = and I am always glad to hear what's exciting or worrisome for Wyomingites. .=C2=A0 I'd like to briefly acknowledge the issue raised this week regarding the di= stribution of donor checks on the House floor=E2=80=94integrity matters. Th= e Legislature only works if the public can trust the institution and the pe= ople serving in it. The Senate will clarify our rules to make it clear that= these actions are not only unacceptable but also not allowed; the House wi= ll move forward with a transparent investigative committee; and other inves= tigations are underway. Public confidence in our institutions has to come f= irst. =C2=A0 I am focused with my Senate colleagues on working hard to bring forth a bud= get we can all live with and add some meaningful bills along the way. =C2=A0 If you're at the session, I hope to see you!=C2=A0 =C2=A0 =C2=A0- Eric=C2=A0 =C2=A0 Barlow Introduces Joint Resolution to Protect Public Lands and Keep Decisio= ns Local =C2=A0 Senator Eric Barlow today introduced a joint resolution reaffirming Wyoming= =E2=80=99s commitment to keeping public lands protected, accessible, and ma= naged through locally driven, multiple-use frameworks that reflect Wyoming= =E2=80=99s heritage, economy, and way of life. =C2=A0 The resolution opposes broad or indiscriminate sales of federal public land= s and calls for meaningful involvement of state and local governments, coun= ties, and affected communities in any decisions related to land management,= exchanges, or disposal. =E2=80=9CPublic lands are part of who we are as Wyoming people,=E2=80=9D Ba= rlow said. =E2=80=9CThey support our economy, our communities, our traditio= ns, and our ability to work, hunt, fish, graze, recreate, and pass these op= portunities on to the next generation. Decisions about these lands shouldn= =E2=80=99t be made in a vacuum by outside interests and Washington, D.C., e= specially without real input from the state of Wyoming and our local govern= ments and communities who live with those decisions every day.=E2=80=9D =C2=A0 Wyoming residents access public lands at a higher rate than any other state= , with approximately 91 percent of the population using federal lands for w= ork, recreation, or subsistence. Natural resource industries tied to public= lands contribute more than $11 billion annually to Wyoming=E2=80=99s econo= my and support a significant portion of the state=E2=80=99s workforce, whil= e agriculture and grazing remain foundational to rural communities.=C2=A0 =C2=A0 The resolution emphasizes Wyoming=E2=80=99s long-standing multiple-use appr= oach, recognizing that responsible resource development, recreation, agricu= lture, conservation, and wildlife management are not competing interests bu= t complementary ones when guided by local knowledge and collaboration. =C2=A0 Barlow noted that existing federal laws already provide pathways for land e= xchanges or limited disposals when a clear public benefit exists, but said = those processes must be efficient, transparent, and rooted in local input r= ather than imposed from outside Wyoming. =C2=A0 =E2=80=9CWhen changes are needed, Wyoming has shown we can work through the= m the right way; =C2=A0with landowners, counties, industry, recreationists,= and conservation interests at the table,=E2=80=9D Barlow said. =E2=80=9CWh= at doesn=E2=80=99t work is top-down decision-making that dictates for Wyomi= ng what is in our best interest and shifts long-term costs and management f= or access, wildfire response, and infrastructure onto local communities wit= hout their consent.=E2=80=9D =C2=A0 The resolution also reaffirms Wyoming=E2=80=99s firearms heritage and state= constitutional protections for hunting, fishing, and trapping, and highlig= hts the role public lands play in supporting youth programs, outdoor tradit= ions, and a thriving recreation and tourism economy. =C2=A0 =E2=80=9C=E2=80=9CPublic lands are America=E2=80=99s best idea and most pre= cious resource. In Wyoming, we use the land, we steward the land, and we wo= rk hard to teach our children to responsibly do the same,=E2=80=9D Barlow s= aid. =C2=A0 There is never a good time to sell off federal lands in Wyoming without tal= king to the ones who love it most, the people of Wyoming.=E2=80=9D=C2=A0 IN THE NEWS=C2=A0 = ystatedaily.com/2026/02/13/wyoming-lawmakers-move-to-bypass-fda-on-stem-cel= l-treatments/?fbclid=3DIwY2xjawPUGxleHRuA2FlbQIxMQBzcnRjBmFwcF9pZBAyMjIwMz= kxNzg4MjAwODkyAAEeiDwfDqi5TPHKFi7TbzsH39NI3V1pxOWhY9cCN9ynklp5f6k3Rz0OYNJrq= I0aemueMcaRJQNkhdIVmOfTaZpg =C2=A0 Cowboy State Daily =E2=80=9CWe=E2=80=99ve got to press on the federal government because they= =E2=80=99re not approving things fast enough. That means states across the country could protect more women, children, and unborn lives from Planned Parenthood's horrific actions.

Planned Parenthood doesn't deserve another dime of public funds--our hard-earned money.

name: AOC
subject: “There are more American delegates here than have ever been at the Munich Security Conference. Why do you think it’s important that you’re here representing the US?”
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
At the Munich Security Conference, someone asked me, “There are more American delegates here than have ever been at the Munich Security Conference. **Why do you think it’s important that _you’re_ here representing the US?**”
This is a moment where we are seeing our presidential administration tear apart the Transatlantic Partnership, rip up every democratic norm, really calling into question — as was mentioned by Canadian Prime Minister Carney at the World Economic Forum — the rules-based order that we have.
So I think that one of the reasons why, not just myself but many Democrats that are here as well, is that **we want to tell a larger story**.
What is happening is indeed very grave. We are in a new era, domestically and globally.
There have been many leaders who’ve said, “We will go back.” And I think that we have to recognize that we are in a new day, and in a new time.
But **that does not mean that the majority of Americans are ready to walk away from a rules-based order, or that we’re ready to walk away from our commitment to democracy**.
We identify that hypocrisy is vulnerability. What we are seeking is a return to a rules-based order that eliminates the hypocrisies, when too often in the West we look the other way from inconvenient populations to act out these paradoxes: whether it’s kidnapping a foreign head of state, threatening our allies to colonize Greenland, or looking the other way in a genocide.
Hypocrisies are vulnerabilities, and they threaten democracies globally.
Many of us are here to say, **we are here and we are ready for the next chapter** — not to have the world turn to isolation, but to deepen our partnership on greater commitment to integrity and our values.
There has been a day before this presidency, and there will be a day after.
**And it belongs to us**.

But that does not mean that the majority of Americans are ready to walk away from a rules-based order, or that we’re ready to walk away from our commitment to democracy. We identify that hypocrisy is vulnerability. What we are seeking is a return to a rules-based order that eliminates the hypocrisies, when too often in the West we look the other way from inconvenient populations to act out these paradoxes: whether it’s kidnapping a foreign head of state, threatening our allies to colonize Greenland, or looking the other way in a genocide. Hypocrisies are vulnerabilities, and they threaten democracies globally. Many of us are here to say, we are here and we are ready for the next chapter — not to have the world turn to isolation, but to deepen our partnership on greater commitment to integrity and our values. There has been a day before this presidency, and there will be a day after. And it belongs to us. In solidarity, Alexandria | ---|--- | | | ---|---|---|--- Email us: mailto: speak@ocasiocortez.com

The use of mail-in voting has become very common across the country and study after study has shown that fraud in mail-ballot voting is rare. There are also several safeguards in place nationwide to protect against fraud, including signature requirements and barcodes to track envelopes sent by officials. States have spent tens of millions of taxpayer dollars investigating voter fraud since 2020's "big lie" and found virtually nothing.

name: Sarah Vroegop
subject: Christina for Congress: Upcoming Volunteer Opportunity
body:
Hi everyone,

Thank you so much for your willingness to volunteer with Christina’s campaign! If you’re getting this email, you have at one point told Christina or me you’d be interested in volunteering, or you signed up to volunteer via our website or google form.

**I’m reaching out because we have a very exciting event coming up - former Congresswoman Gabby Giffords is joining us for a panel discussion on ending gun violence.** The invitation is attached below.

**In order to help promote, we’d love your help making phone calls to spread the word.** We’ll give you a short list of people to call, you’ll get a script to follow, an email template, and all the information you’ll need to answer questions about Christina or the campaign.

You’ll also only be calling Democrats who have supported Christina’s campaign in the area, so these will be friendly folks on the other end of the line!

If you have an hour or two between now and the end of the day on Feb. 22, please let me know, and I’ll get you set up with materials. Also, we’d of course love to have you there!

If you don’t have time this week but still want to help with calls in the future, don’t worry! We’ll have more opportunities soon. Please let me know if you’d be interested in helping out in the upcoming weeks for some of our events in March.

Thanks all!

Best,
\--

**Sarah Vroegop**
Campaign Manager | [Christina Hines for Congress](https://www.christinahinesforcongress.com/)
616.886.5174

body:
After Analilia Mejia’s historic victory over the political machine in New Jersey this month, we’re fighting to send another WFP champion to Congress in just a little over two weeks. | | | Peter, After Analilia Mejia’s historic victory over the political machine in New Jersey this month, we’re fighting to send _another_ WFP champion to Congress in just a little over two weeks. But we need your help to do it. **Nida Allam’s primary for North Carolina’s 4th Congressional District is on March 3rd.** And she’s fighting for affordable housing, Medicare for All, ending the influence of corporate PACs, and so much more. But she’s up against an incumbent who won the seat thanks to MILLIONS of dollars from AIPAC and crypto billionaires.1 **If we want to build upon the political shockwave started by WFP champs like Zohran Mamdani and Analilia Mejia, then we’ll need to put everything we have into powering Nida Allam to victory.** [**Split a donation right now between Nida Allam and the Working Families Party to help make calls, knock on doors, and turn out voters for our next working-class champion.**](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquqxZ_WMtWQ5nsYnjR236T9DtY5cIV1tEmyZ3NC_cxRbTdNF129-HbwHuuYQZDVPsy65vf-MuUlC3YeRYlLD89sOJxkRMSuQuafhnIg4067bpcw4uRgh27fwBFRbRke-xgDfvP4SD4G1xq1J87CT1Wu9udzWwMeCUweT_PD6JGEyOuEZnWBLaphq1eKjx_xKogMD-VIsBte7V0i-DhjvVLXU56_E82qKaWpGZyJTv0nwvP026VfNRwjSuLW-GfSdxPOL1t0dVklpCw8OI0IdRxVz_tKbM_Ks54aEzU8tiO-9R6gwUBhOLb68CFGvliSOTWJmQ1dcUh-ucPenAPBhjbGw2bhBsSDgP3Z-uPIKvw2YUeS0VnSEPZvFVhg2LR6XV8/4o7/pgMNVO5lSTO8JA7ka7J-6A/h0/h001.XLwLFs8FgXX3toq6u7s_JfxtCTP2yNbxURaguwdATiM) **[Donate $10 »](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquqxZ_WMtWQ5nsYnjR236T9DtY5cIV1tEmyZ3NC_cxRbTdNF129-HbwHuuYQZDVPsy65vf-MuUlC3YeRYlLD89shdVpPToSzOZAW0jfGqzQCRcBTTHGGw51_kA4FfarfOPKuS6GzwwxenJTi_R4imPOmFSdTO_goW7mhBh3qyaV-5ODForuYSKX5DKQ_F8q5XR7T78eCLHgWsRTaV7dDpKEPLI_IEsRt-qHaphX74C6jzFbJ9u0jg2_Ighd9revntAyMD-A_AuUxzPiU0Ku0agKL3PqxXwEAwzISADBAhRlxJSAh51rc3-SyAm0Kdoh4o-1Jt3h0P2m-60YgHN3_JY03j5bI1s1i4jEGJNsIaHYag0c-d7Dn7Mhl27qbuVgZL0/4o7/pgMNVO5lSTO8JA7ka7J-6A/h1/h001.dRHQD3sD_YAVfIbMpuRWDssXD4_oOuZb6tUTgreS9AI)** Peter, working people across the country have had enough. And if the last year and change has taught us anything, it’s that we can’t defeat Trump and Republicans by running the same old playbook. Nida has roots in her community. She’s a County Commissioner who helped raise the minimum wage for county employees, delivered property tax relief for Durham residents, and helped protect Durham’s immigrant community. Now she’s running for Congress to pass transformative legislation like Medicare for All and a Green New Deal. We know AIPAC, crypto billionaires, and the politicians they bankroll do not care about working families. clean_body: After Analilia Mejia’s historic victory over the political machine in New Jersey this month, we’re fighting to send another WFP champion to Congress in just a little over two weeks. | | | Peter, After Analilia Mejia’s historic victory over the political machine in New Jersey this month, we’re fighting to send another WFP champion to Congress in just a little over two weeks. But we need your help to do it. Nida Allam’s primary for North Carolina’s 4th Congressional District is on March 3rd. And she’s fighting for affordable housing, Medicare for All, ending the influence of corporate PACs, and so much more. But she’s up against an incumbent who won the seat thanks to MILLIONS of dollars from AIPAC and crypto billionaires.1 If we want to build upon the political shockwave started by WFP champs like Zohran Mamdani and Analilia Mejia, then we’ll need to put everything we have into powering Nida Allam to victory. Peter, working people across the country have had enough. And if the last year and change has taught us anything, it’s that we can’t defeat Trump and Republicans by running the same old playbook. Nida has roots in her community. She’s a County Commissioner who helped raise the minimum wage for county employees, delivered property tax relief for Durham residents, and helped protect Durham’s immigrant community. Now she’s running for Congress to pass transformative legislation like Medicare for All and a Green New Deal. We know AIPAC, crypto billionaires, and the politicians they bankroll do not care about working families. So when they decide to spend millions of dollars against a candidate like Nida Allam, we all should take notice. We need more leaders like Nida in Congress. People who don’t just talk about working families, but actually show up for them. In solidarity, Working Families Party Source: 1\. , The Assembly, May 10, 2022 Thoughts? Feedback? body:
ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/Non-Re-Elect%20Logo.png]
This Presidents’ Day, originally established to celebrate our first president, I’m thinking about President Washington, and President Lincoln, and the other presidents of the United States who have served our country with principle and patriotism. Over the last year, we have seen the opposite too many times. But our history is instructive. American presidents have been called upon in moments of great uncertainty and turmoil and have demonstrated to the rest of us how to meet the moment.
Their leadership reminds us that even in dark and uncertain periods, our country has still found its way forward through the courage and commitment of people who refuse to give up on the promise of America. I hold on to that lesson every day as we work to protect our democracy, defend our freedoms, and build a future that includes all Americans.
I know everyone on #TeamLizzie feels the same way. And one of the most important ways we can honor this vision—and the work to ensure equal rights and opportunity for all—is by participating in our democracy.
Early voting in Texas’ primary elections begins tomorrow, February 17—and I’ll be voting. From now through November, we must participate in democracy in many ways—inlcuding but not limited to voting. Of course, we will mobilize voters, organize our communities, and work together to take back the House of Representatives and restore accountability in Washington.
It’s more important than ever that we elect leaders who will stand up for our communities, our country, and our Constitution. Voting in the primaries is an important part of making that happen.
Together we can do anything,

clean_body: ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS [] This Presidents’ Day, originally established to celebrate our first president, I’m thinking about President Washington, and President Lincoln, and the other presidents of the United States who have served our country with principle and patriotism. Over the last year, we have seen the opposite too many times. But our history is instructive. American presidents have been called upon in moments of great uncertainty and turmoil and have demonstrated to the rest of us how to meet the moment. Their leadership reminds us that even in dark and uncertain periods, our country has still found its way forward through the courage and commitment of people who refuse to give up on the promise of America. I hold on to that lesson every day as we work to protect our democracy, defend our freedoms, and build a future that includes all Americans. I know everyone on #TeamLizzie feels the same way. And one of the most important ways we can honor this vision—and the work to ensure equal rights and opportunity for all—is by participating in our democracy. Early voting in Texas’ primary elections begins tomorrow, February 17—and I’ll be voting. From now through November, we must participate in democracy in many ways—inlcuding but not limited to voting. Of course, we will mobilize voters, organize our communities, and work together to take back the House of Representatives and restore accountability in Washington. It’s more important than ever that we elect leaders who will stand up for our communities, our country, and our Constitution. Voting in the primaries is an important part of making that happen. body:
Every generation has leaders who stood up and said: Healthcare is a human right.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/125518269/602040476/966921121?refcode=email_021626_presidentsday&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjIvMS8xMjAxOTgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNTI3NjAyZjItNzIwYi1mMTExLTgzMmUtMDAyMjQ4MmE5NzMzIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=7OH6UBPGQ8R7WQb1SvhV_8G-x739O0-IbQ58NirYeeg=) Peter, Happy Presidents' Day. While most campaigns are taking the day off, I wanted to share something with you. This morning, I was thinking about FDR and his fight for Social Security. About Harry Truman, who tried to pass universal healthcare 70 years ago. About LBJ and Medicare. **Every generation has leaders who stood up and said: Healthcare is a human right.** But here we are in 2026, and families in the Lehigh Valley are still rationing insulin. Still going bankrupt from medical bills. Still choosing between prescriptions and groceries. In 2023, 20 million Americans were stuck with $220 billion in medical debt, while 16 of the biggest drug companies raked in $684 billion. We spend more per-capita than any other developed nation, with lower life expectancies. Ryan Mackenzie voted to gut Medicaid through his One Big Beautiful Bill — kicking thousands of our neighbors off their healthcare so he could fund more tax breaks for his billionaire buddies. I spent 20 years as a firefighter. I've carried people out of burning buildings. And I've seen too many good people destroyed by a healthcare system that puts profits over people. That's why I'm fighting for Medicare for All. You shouldn't have to run into a burning building to get healthcare from your government or wait until you turn 65. I'll also fight to bring down drug prices, stop healthcare companies from price gouging, restore the cuts to Medicaid, and make sure every town has the doctors and clinics people actually need. But we can't win this fight without you. With 91 days until the primary, we need to raise $25,000 this week to get our healthcare message on TV and in mailboxes across PA-07. _Was it because of the alternate halftime show?_
Dear Valued Subscriber and Movie & Music Lovers,
The ratings are finally in, and for the first time in five years, viewership for the **Super Bowl** halftime show actually declined over the previous year.
Of course the Apple Music halftime show was controversial as soon as it was announced that Puerto Rican rapper Bad Bunny would be headlining, drawing criticism for his outspoken statements against President Donald Trump and his immigration policy. Many conservatives saw his selection as a middle finger to Trump and vowed to boycott the show, and Turning Point USA even organized an **alternate halftime show** in response.
The stakes were obviously high for everybody involved: If the Turning Point USA All-American Halftime Show turned out to be a flop that nobody watched, it would show the NFL that the conservative outrage really didn't matter in the end. And if Bad Bunny didn't draw the numbers the NFL was looking for in attempting to appeal to a broader community, there's no doubt it would be blamed on the conservative boycott and the TPUSA alternate broadcast.
**So what do the numbers say?**
Well first the good news for the NFL: The halftime show drew an average of 128 million viewers, making it the fourth highest viewed halftime show on record, behind Kendrick Lamar in 2025, Michael Jackson in 1993, and Usher in 2024.
The bad news though? For the first time in 5 years, Bad Bunny failed to increase the viewership from last year's halftime show.
In 2025, Kendrick Lamar set a record with an average of 133.5 million viewers. That was an increase of more than 10 million over Usher in 2024, who drew in an average of 123.4 million. And in fact, the audience for the halftime show had grown every year since The Weeknd performed in 2021 - until this year.

This year, I am up for re-election. I made the left furious by leading Senate Republicans to flip seats in Montana, West Virginia, Ohio, and Pennsylvania. We must compete with the massive sums Democrat donors are throwing into races nationwide. body:
What it looks like to take our power back.
# [](https://act.mcmorrowformichigan.com/go/685?refcode=&t=1&akid=4078%2E898137%2EJFmSNR)
Hey team —
There’s a specific sound that happens when people finally realize they have their power back.
**It’s the thunderous applause I heard echoing in the Michigan Capitol when we did the “impossible” and repealed so-called Right to Work.** I felt that same energy again when speaking at the Senate candidate forum hosted by the United Auto Workers.
For too long, we’ve been told to settle. Settle for rhetoric over results. Settle for leaders who are beholden to corporate interests instead of standing up for you.
I’m not interested in settling.
At this forum, I laid out exactly what it looks like when we stop playing defense and start delivering. **_My GOP opponent, Mike Rogers, didn’t even bother to show up._**
Since Mike Rogers was missing in action, I wanted to be sure our message that he was too afraid to hear was delivered loud and clear.
[](https://act.mcmorrowformichigan.com/go/1039?refcode=AU_MAM_EG_GEN_GEN_AC_20260216_PM1_V1_S1&t=2&akid=4078%2E898137%2EJFmSNR)

## 52-Year-Old Austrian Back at Olympics
Austria's Claudia Riegler competed in her fifth Winter Olympics in Milano, Italy, on Sunday, racing in the parallel giant slalom [at age 52](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDGu2zAQRE8jdTKWS5qiChZp3P20KQWau5Q3oESBYmzo9oEC5AS_HAwwmPd-fc1fQbJsy8-wsk9Lmlsq88afI3NrXOc7nhxqyVTyue4Stlhl5STLjIB2AByUnSlIPmfTk0_MyLpnr8ZR4Xh3TvcvH5OiadLWhUTakX4mFcE6Si7y3emxF3-tASqLCoyBm57ABaOZng4wKegMMEkr9fa7yNZenPJZ3lxvsax99q_W9qPTPzp8dPgI-wVwVVeoTWLmDh8l0_CfYji28nmWUInrMcQc_pCEoQovmesAT5hGSgmVdRFBTQQBdbIGEhgk01dP-0dylsOOnYFlDZL_XWnfdvj2-DcAAP__AbCGRw). She qualified 16th out of 36 riders and advanced to the elimination rounds [before falling](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGu3CAQRb_G7rBgMLZfQZHG3aZNac3CwE6EYYXZtfz30SbKF7z-6ujc8-u23ZAT5_gTd7Ihhq2FsmU6j0StUd0MXIS1JF_StT8Zs6u8U-C4gYRJSBBq2jxyurax9zYQAemerJpnBbNZFt0_rA5OK6ORZr186QABjDbeoUEVDJLq2X5oEtQESo6jHPSXXHDU5O-LhKBkN0ry3EodfhfO7UEhXeVNdXBl75N9tPY8Ov2jg7WD9TzPId_dP2N3fDYdrJ9THawGBL6OVhmzOHI57wWrpypcwpdnFJUpJqqiouMcBUbkfDSBkcTOCbNwpTbOKP7j-2r98-SU-JjmbpRxR05_vdq3g74t_AkAAP__epiOtg) to two-time defending gold medalist Ester Ledecka, 22 years her junior. Riegler made her Olympic debut at Salt Lake City in 2002, one year before Czech rider Zuzana Maderova, the current gold medalist, was born. At 30, she was once cut from Austria's team for being "too old." She fought her way back, won a world championship in 2015, and has logged more than 400 World Cup starts. She says next year's world championships in Austria could be her last.
## Toddler, Dog Share Tiny Lifesaver
A 3-year-old boy and a small Chiweenie dog from Los Angeles are connected by more than fate. subject: A day in my life
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY DEB FOR NEW MEXICO**
body:
Can I take a minute of your time to give you a sneak peek into my everyday life?

| | | [](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/134?t=1&akid=7511%2E400544%2EgtqzTs)
---
Hi friend,

I want to take a minute and bring you into my everyday life — the long days, the real conversations, the moments that remind me exactly why I’m running to be the next governor of New Mexico. Before I share more, I have to ask: ** _[Will you chip in $5 or whatever you can spare to help me become the next governor of New Mexico?](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/5042?refcode=jtk269-fr-nd&t=2&akid=7511%2E400544%2EgtqzTs)_**
| | [Donate](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/4677?refcode=jtk269-fr-nd&t=3&akid=7511%2E400544%2EgtqzTs)
---
My morning starts out pretty simple, folks:

My alarm goes off at 5:45 a.m. I slip into my moccasins and head to the kitchen for my morning coffee. I read the news and answer my emails, and by 9 a.m., I'm heading to my campaign office for work.
[](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/4677?refcode=jtk269-fr-nd&t=4&akid=7511%2E400544%2EgtqzTs)
Working on my campaign for New Mexico governor looks different every day — **but my favorite days are those when I'm out meeting and connecting with people in our very own communities.** I love getting to say hello, listen to new stories, and share our bold, compassionate vision for New Mexico’s future.
**_
[It's why I'm in this race, friend, to be the leader who will move us toward a future where everyone can thrive.](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/4677?refcode=jtk269-fr-nd&t=5&akid=7511%2E400544%2EgtqzTs)_**
[](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/4677?refcode=jtk269-fr-nd&t=6&akid=7511%2E400544%2EgtqzTs)
[](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/4677?refcode=jtk269-fr-nd&t=7&akid=7511%2E400544%2EgtqzTs)
When I can squeeze in a little non-campaign time (which isn’t often these days), you’ll usually find me out enjoying everything New Mexico has to offer — from running across our vast, diverse landscapes to cooking delicious New Mexican cuisine. In fact, while I was Secretary of the Interior, I ran the Boston Marathon and the Canyon Des Ultra Marathon. And this year, I'm hoping to sign up for a half marathon or two!
[](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/4677?refcode=jtk269-fr-nd&t=8&akid=7511%2E400544%2EgtqzTs)
**I am of and for New Mexico, friend, blessed to come from 35 generations of resilient and fierce Pueblo women.** My family, friends, and neighbors have all shaped my values and my commitment to fight for the communities that raised me.
I’m sharing about my days because I want you to know what drives me. I understand affordability because I was a single mother living paycheck to paycheck. I lived in a small apartment above a garage so my child could grow up in a safer community and attend a better school. And I understand the need for accessible healthcare because I relied on Planned Parenthood and WIC when I didn’t have it. These issues are personal to me.
I’ve also led at the highest levels of government, serving in Congress and as U.S. Secretary of the Interior. I’ve taken on tough fights and delivered real results. I know how to stand up for working families and get things done.
**Experience matters. Leadership matters. I’m ready.** _But the truth is I can't win this race without your help._
**Every day from now until Election Day is absolutely critical, and I wouldn't ask if it weren’t urgent:_[Will you please chip in $5 — or any amount you can afford — to fund my campaign so we can deliver real progress for New Mexican working families?](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/4677?refcode=jtk269-fr-nd&t=9&akid=7511%2E400544%2EgtqzTs)_**
| | [Donate](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/4677?refcode=jtk269-fr-nd&t=10&akid=7511%2E400544%2EgtqzTs)
---
Thank you so much for your support, friend. I know that, together, we can build a brighter future for our families and kids.

Be fierce,

clean_body: Can I take a minute of your time to give you a sneak peek into my everyday life? | | | Hi friend, I want to take a minute and bring you into my everyday life — the long days, the real conversations, the moments that remind me exactly why I’m running to be the next governor of New Mexico. Before I share more, I have to ask: | | My morning starts out pretty simple, folks: My alarm goes off at 5:45 a.m. I slip into my moccasins and head to the kitchen for my morning coffee. I read the news and answer my emails, and by 9 a.m., I'm heading to my campaign office for work. Working on my campaign for New Mexico governor looks different every day — but my favorite days are those when I'm out meeting and connecting with people in our very own communities. I love getting to say hello, listen to new stories, and share our bold, compassionate vision for New Mexico’s future. When I can squeeze in a little non-campaign time (which isn’t often these days), you’ll usually find me out enjoying everything New Mexico has to offer — from running across our vast, diverse landscapes to cooking delicious New Mexican cuisine. In fact, while I was Secretary of the Interior, I ran the Boston Marathon and the Canyon Des Ultra Marathon. And this year, I'm hoping to sign up for a half marathon or two! I am of and for New Mexico, friend, blessed to come from 35 generations of resilient and fierce Pueblo women. My family, friends, and neighbors have all shaped my values and my commitment to fight for the communities that raised me. I’m sharing about my days because I want you to know what drives me. I understand affordability because I was a single mother living paycheck to paycheck. I lived in a small apartment above a garage so my child could grow up in a safer community and attend a better school. And I understand the need for accessible healthcare because I relied on Planned Parenthood and WIC when I didn’t have it. These issues are personal to me. I’ve also led at the highest levels of government, serving in Congress and as U.S. Secretary of the Interior. I’ve taken on tough fights and delivered real results. I know how to stand up for working families and get things done. Experience matters. Leadership matters. I’m ready. But the truth is I can't win this race without your help. Every day from now until Election Day is absolutely critical, and I wouldn't ask if it weren’t urgent: | | Thank you so much for your support, friend. I know that, together, we can build a brighter future for our families and kids. Be fierce, Deb | | | | |

* * *
_**By David Shuster**_
For all the turmoil Donald Trump has inflicted on our nation in his 2nd Presidential term, last week's revelation that his Department of Justice sought to indict sitting members of Congress for advising members of the U.S. military to disobey unlawful orders should rank among the most ominous.
This wasn't merely politicized legal brinkmanship. It was an attempted coup by prosecutorial fiat, one that was luckily stymied by a grand jury panel of ordinary citizens.
The panel was asked to return criminal charges against members of Congress who produced a video that did nothing more incendiary than restate the oath sworn by every recruit who has ever put on the uniform. Their crime, apparently, was to suggest that the Constitution is not a decorative pamphlet but binding law.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/43041e6f-1213-4294-8fc7-027d400d75c9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYmx1ZWFtcC5jby9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.awbN6vE0Jd5PBf-cweDuR1cgYTFVF_j_ZozAjq3adCc?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=187910824)
* * *
The six culprits were not campus activists or marxist revolutionaries. They were, inconveniently, veterans and national security professionals: Senators Elissa Slotkin and Mark Kelly; Representatives Maggie Goodlander, Jason Crow, Chrissy Houlahan, and Chris Deluzio. Their message was plain: members of the armed forces have a duty to refuse unlawful commands. It was the sort of sentiment one might expect to find on a military recruiting poster.
To the lunatic mind of Trump, however, this constituted a subversive threat. Trump publicly demanded the lawmakers be punished for "traitorous" conduct. On social media, Trump even claimed the democrats were guilty of "seditious behavior punishable by death."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/43041e6f-1213-4294-8fc7-027d400d75c9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Unhinged rhetoric is one thing. Using the Justice Department -- an agency meant to be independent of personal politics -- to pursue criminal charges against elected members of another branch of government is quite another.
And that takes us Attorney General Pam Bondi and U.S. Attorney for the District of Columbia Jeanine Pirro.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/43041e6f-1213-4294-8fc7-027d400d75c9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=3722532&post_id=187910824&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTg3OTEwODI0LCJpYXQiOjE3NzEyODA4NjQsImV4cCI6MTc3Mzg3Mjg2NCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTM3MjI1MzIiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.XifxIIcHCRN1SPtpCgmBav5J4PEaCBQHOAXJlK_X3qg)
* * *
Under orders from Bondi, Pirro took material from the video and sought a grand jury criminal indictment. According to multiple reports, Pirro and her team of prosecutors told the grand jurors the six lawmakers had undermined the "loyalty, morale, or discipline" of the armed forces -- a phrase so elastic it could ensnare anyone who has ever cracked a joke about a general.
And then something extraordinary occurred: the grand jury refused to indict.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/43041e6f-1213-4294-8fc7-027d400d75c9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
It is worth underscoring that grand juries are not famous for their rebellious spirit. There is that old saying that a prosecutor can persuade a grand jury to indict a ham sandwich. Indeed, once prosecutors present charges, the rate at which grand juries return true bills is extraordinarily high. That's why this rebuff is so newsworthy. In this case, ordinary citizens, anonymous Washington, D.C. residents, rejected the government's theory and declined to convert political speech into a felony. The panel determined that the DOJ's case, no matter how politically charged, did not rise to the level of criminal conduct.
Still, let's be clear about what the Trump administration attempted. This was not just a case of overzealous prosecution. It was a Trump/Bondi effort -- however clumsy -- to use the machinery of criminal law against members of a coequal branch of government for articulating a constitutional principle.
* * *
[Leave a comment](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=3722532&post_id=187910824&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&isFreemail=true&comments=true&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTg3OTEwODI0LCJpYXQiOjE3NzEyODA4NjQsImV4cCI6MTc3Mzg3Mjg2NCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTM3MjI1MzIiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.XifxIIcHCRN1SPtpCgmBav5J4PEaCBQHOAXJlK_X3qg&r=1hvr60&utm_campaign=email-half-magic-comments&action=post-comment)
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/43041e6f-1213-4294-8fc7-027d400d75c9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
If that is not a species of coup, then the word has lost its meaning. A coup need not be accompanied by military forces or January 6 oath keepers storming the capitol and attacking capitol police; it may proceed by subpoena.
The American system depends on friction. Congress is meant to irritate the executive; the executive is meant to frustrate Congress; the courts are meant to vex them both. Out of this mutual annoyance comes liberty. When one branch seeks to criminalize the speech of another, it is not engaging in friction. It is reaching for domination.
Defenders of Trump now insist that no harm was done -- that the grand jury's refusal proves the system works. And yes, for the moment, the guardrails have held. But it is worth remembering that a bank robber who points a gun at a bank teller, gets thwarted, and fails to steal bags full of cash has still attempted armed robbery.
The fact that the citizens of Washington, D.C., refused to indict the six members of Congress does not erase the insidious Trump appetite that inspired this prosecution effort.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/43041e6f-1213-4294-8fc7-027d400d75c9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---

* * *
Indeed, the more troubling question is what happens next time. We've seen with Trump that when he finds the courts inconvenient, he and his goons seek other avenues.
They have engaged in administrative harassment, endless investigations, the stripping of security clearances, and the ignoring of court orders. The Trump team thrives on power and has never shown restraint.
It is part of a broader Trump administration pattern. Over the past year, Trump and his agents have displayed a casual relationship with constitutional constraints -- particularly those contained in the First, Fourth, and Fourteenth Amendments.
The press is denounced as enemy; searches and seizures are defended with elastic interpretations; equal protection is treated as an optional accessory.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/43041e6f-1213-4294-8fc7-027d400d75c9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=3722532&post_id=187910824&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTg3OTEwODI0LCJpYXQiOjE3NzEyODA4NjQsImV4cCI6MTc3Mzg3Mjg2NCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTM3MjI1MzIiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.XifxIIcHCRN1SPtpCgmBav5J4PEaCBQHOAXJlK_X3qg)
* * *
Each maneuver, promoted and defended by Trump sycophants including Karoline Leavitt, is justified as necessary, urgent, and patriotic. Each chips away at our constitutional republic.
Democracies seldom perish in a blaze. They expire from neglect, from the steady normalization of the outrageous. What would have provoked outrage a few days ago becomes today's mere partisan skirmish and tomorrow's settled practice.
The attempted indictment of six lawmakers for urging obedience to lawful authority is not merely another headline. It is a test balloon. It asks whether the public will tolerate the conversion of disagreement into criminality. For now, a grand jury has answered no. But grand juries are summoned case by case. Vigilance must be continuous.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/43041e6f-1213-4294-8fc7-027d400d75c9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The U.S. Constitution, while a stubborn document, is not self-executing. It relies on citizens who prefer law over tyranny. And it depends on officials who recognize that power is a public trust, not a trophy.
Donald Trump and his sycophants at the Department of Justice sought to imprison lawmakers for repeating the plain meaning of the military's constitutional oath. The Trump effort was imperialistic and reeked of fascism.
This week, ordinary citizens blocked that Trump endeavor
The rejection is cause for relief, not complacency.

name: Ted Cruz
subject: This is personal, and important
body:
This message may be a bit different from what you're used to, but frankly, it's quite personal and important.

| | | | |
---
Friend, This message may be a bit different from what you're used to, but frankly, it's quite personal and important. I'd like you to read this passage with me from Hebrews 13:3: _"Continue to remember those in prison as if you were together with them in prison, and those who are mistreated as if you yourselves were suffering."_ _ _ **As a follower of Christ, nothing weighs heavier on my heart than the suffering of our brothers and sisters who are paying the ultimate price for their faith.** I've seen the reports, heard the stories personally, and fought in the U.S. Senate to shine a light on this darkness because their pain is real, raw, and relentless. They aren't distant statistics - _they're our family in Christ._ _Since 2009 in Nigeria, it's estimated that**over 100,000 Christians have been massacred, 20,000 churches have been destroyed** , and **over 5 million have been displaced.**_ _In China, it is not uncommon for faithful believers to be**arrested simply for gathering to worship** , to have their **homes raided** , and their **leaders imprisoned**._ _In Sudan, Islamist paramilitaries have long been on a rampage - **bombing churches** , and **killing priests and worshippers** sheltering inside while forcing survivors to **convert or be killed**. In some cases, crucified._ **Many don't realize it, but Christians are the most persecuted religious group on the planet, facing torture, rape, enslavement, and murder. At least 380 million endure heavy persecution - 60% of them children, with girls and women suffering the most violation.** My faith demands I act, illustrated quite clearly in the verse I shared above, and I'd like to personally - _and urgently_ - ask you to do so as well. **Save The Persecuted Christians is a vital non-profit organization engaged in this fight on the front lines by raising awareness, providing a megaphone to survivors, briefing lawmakers and government officials, and pushing relentlessly for real policy changes and accountability.** **[Simply put, they are saving lives and saving souls and I'm urging you to help with an emergency, tax-deductible donation today.](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyUkMFqxCAURb_G7Az6TMx04aJ0CHQxXbbL4OibREhU9CUD_fqSQj-gu7u4XO45X7fpZsMa4vxhNzTuCFOpEy2hhpqx1BTtaqMPW06FbJxAgOYCuNRnTzbeOK8VNGjkMEgYhg5ksxgLQgsPTvbqcb94713vHYgB7tADWtkEcy4JkBqkEvKlddBDDxfs4GFx8Jp1Ys_eEtbWpVixHJbCgSHGdKYUW5e2ZjULUa5MvTIYGYw-RUvYVnsgLXgCoNsJvVtKqBRsrG0qM4OR0HNX9m--4L3gs0rFFa9LKjRlnlNmaizo9lJCnJm6UtmRgd5pm8gxdX37fAf-R9AU4_MzrGuoemCdmDcb1t979H-hh4GfAAAA__8Lt4aZ)**
[SAVE CHRISTIANS NOW](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyUkMFqxCAURb_G7Az6TMx04aJ0CHQxXbbL4OibREhU9CUD_fqSQj-gu7u4XO45X7fpZsMa4vxhNzTuCFOpEy2hhpqx1BTtaqMPW06FbJxAgOYCuNRnTzbeOK8VNGjkMEgYhg5ksxgLQgsPTvbqcb94713vHYgB7tADWtkEcy4JkBqkEvKlddBDDxfs4GFx8Jp1Ys_eEtbWpVixHJbCgSHGdKYUW5e2ZjULUa5MvTIYGYw-RUvYVnsgLXgCoNsJvVtKqBRsrG0qM4OR0HNX9m--4L3gs0rFFa9LKjRlnlNmaizo9lJCnJm6UtmRgd5pm8gxdX37fAf-R9AU4_MzrGuoemCdmDcb1t979H-hh4GfAAAA__8Lt4aZ)
We cannot stand idly by while evil targets the faithful. It's time to rally around our persecuted family, to show them they are not forgotten, that their American brothers and sisters stand with them in prayer and action. To fund its efforts across the globe, Save the Persecuted Christians has been in the midst of an aggressive, nationwide fundraising campaign and I'm told _**today 's stretch goal is 350 new donations by midnight.**_ **So please, don 't hesitate.** This group is leading a coalition of _over 200 organizations_ to help exert maximum pressure wherever it's needed most. They are tireless and effective, and [your generous support will go a long way.](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyUkMFqxCAURb_G7Az6TMx04aJ0CHQxXbbL4OibREhU9CUD_fqSQj-gu7u4XO45X7fpZsMa4vxhNzTuCFOpEy2hhpqx1BTtaqMPW06FbJxAgOYCuNRnTzbeOK8VNGjkMEgYhg5ksxgLQgsPTvbqcb94713vHYgB7tADWtkEcy4JkBqkEvKlddBDDxfs4GFx8Jp1Ys_eEtbWpVixHJbCgSHGdKYUW5e2ZjULUa5MvTIYGYw-RUvYVnsgLXgCoNsJvVtKqBRsrG0qM4OR0HNX9m--4L3gs0rFFa9LKjRlnlNmaizo9lJCnJm6UtmRgd5pm8gxdX37fAf-R9AU4_MzrGuoemCdmDcb1t979H-hh4GfAAAA__8Lt4aZ) Thank you for your time today. May God bless you,
Ted Cruz

subject: Presidents' Day is about the Constitution, not one man.

body:
In America, no one is above the law.
Today is Presidents' Day, Peter.

It's a reminder of our democracy — of a Constitution carefully and deliberately written so that no one person would hold too much power.

Our founders understood what unchecked authority could do. It's why they built a system of checks and balances, with three coequal branches of government serving as guardrails and ensuring accountability.

_That's the promise of America:_ equal rights, full accountability, and a government that responds to the people, not one man.

**And yet, every single day, Donald Trump tests those boundaries.**

He ignores Congress and counts on the Republican majorities being afraid to stand up to him.

He attacks judges when they rule against him.

He assigns his Department of Justice to prosecute his political enemies.

He uses the power of the pardon to enrich himself, and the power of the office to extract personal favors from foreign governments.

He threatens that his political party will take over free and fair elections nationwide.

And he governs in terms of loyalty to himself instead of loyalty to the Constitution.

**Peter, this isn’t leadership, and it's certainly not what our founders fought so hard for.**

But I believe this administration has severely underestimated the American people. They don't believe we're paying attention, or that we'll come together and stand united against a common threat. But history says otherwise. And the midterm elections in November will be our chance to prove them wrong.

We'll have our first real opportunity to show this president that we don't agree with the direction he's taking our country. If we want to protect our checks and balances, the Constitution, and remind Washington that power belongs to the people, then we'll all need to show up and deliver for our democracy.

clean_body: In America, no one is above the law. Today is Presidents' Day, Peter. It's a reminder of our democracy — of a Constitution carefully and deliberately written so that no one person would hold too much power. Our founders understood what unchecked authority could do. It's why they built a system of checks and balances, with three coequal branches of government serving as guardrails and ensuring accountability. That's the promise of America: equal rights, full accountability, and a government that responds to the people, not one man. And yet, every single day, Donald Trump tests those boundaries. He ignores Congress and counts on the Republican majorities being afraid to stand up to him. He attacks judges when they rule against him. He assigns his Department of Justice to prosecute his political enemies. He uses the power of the pardon to enrich himself, and the power of the office to extract personal favors from foreign governments. He threatens that his political party will take over free and fair elections nationwide. And he governs in terms of loyalty to himself instead of loyalty to the Constitution. Peter, this isn’t leadership, and it's certainly not what our founders fought so hard for. But I believe this administration has severely underestimated the American people. They don't believe we're paying attention, or that we'll come together and stand united against a common threat. But history says otherwise. And the midterm elections in November will be our chance to prove them wrong. We'll have our first real opportunity to show this president that we don't agree with the direction he's taking our country. If we want to protect our checks and balances, the Constitution, and remind Washington that power belongs to the people, then we'll all need to show up and deliver for our democracy. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | = | | = ---|---|---|---|--- = | | = | | = ---|---|---|---|--- Thanks for always stepping up, Andy | Kentucky Gov. | | Peter,
Tomorrow is the day—**early voting begins Tuesday, February 17, 2026** , and runs through Friday, February 27, 2026. Election Day follows on **Tuesday, March 3, 2026**.
This is your moment to make your voice heard in the Republican Primary for Texas’ 21st Congressional District.
The field is crowded, which means **every single vote counts**. A handful of ballots could decide who represents the Hill Country and San Antonio suburbs in Congress for the next two years. That person will have a direct say on border security, election integrity, fiscal responsibility, protecting life, defending the Second Amendment, and advancing America First policies.
I’m asking for your vote—and one more thing: **please bring a friend to vote with you**. One extra conservative ballot could be the difference in this tight race. Together, we can turn out the strong, principled support TX-21 needs to send a proven fighter to Washington.
All the details you need—locations, hours, what to bring—are available at:
[**Voting in Person in Texas**](https://Trey4TX.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c9a64ea8a402e6526a97d9207&id=d0fc973469&e=4d3fe76c62)
Whether you vote early, starting tomorrow, or on Election Day March 3, your participation is what will decide this primary.
I’m honored to have your support and humbled by the trust so many of you have placed in me. Let’s show up strong, bring others with us, and win this seat for the values we share.
Early voting starts **tomorrow** —mark your calendar, grab a friend, and let’s make our voices heard!
For God, For Family, For Texas,

name: Adam Schiff
subject: Trump wants to take over our elections
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY SCHIFF FOR SENATE
body:
| Add your name to show our elections aren’t for sale.
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=9534%2E5257348%2EiKh4Z7)
** Did you see this news, Derek? The New York Times recently reported that Donald Trump and his allies are pushing to nationalize elections — _handing control over how we vote to the federal government, in order to suppress the vote and threaten the result._ [](https://act.adamschiff.com/signup/EG_2602_VotingRights?refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_PET_AC90_20260216_PM1_V1_S1&t=4&akid=9534%2E5257348%2EiKh4Z7) This would rip power away from the states, violating a constitutional guardrail that has protected our elections – and made them run well –**for generations.** [_**With our democracy at risk, I’m asking you to stand with me by adding your name in support of free and fair elections administered by STATES, not TRUMP.**_](https://act.adamschiff.com/signup/EG_2602_VotingRights?refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_PET_AC90_20260216_PM1_V1_S1&t=5&akid=9534%2E5257348%2EiKh4Z7) ** | [ ADD YOUR NAME ](https://act.adamschiff.com/signup/EG_2602_VotingRights?refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_PET_AC90_20260216_PM1_V1_S1&t=6&akid=9534%2E5257348%2EiKh4Z7)
---
**
We know what happened last time Trump lost an election. He incited a violent insurrection at the Capitol, resulting in death threats to elected officials, violence against law enforcement, and the worst attack on our democracy in recent history.
Now, he's trying to discredit our elections before they take place, so he can challenge the result if — as he fully expects — voters reject his ruinous policies.
**We cannot let this latest power grab succeed. The Congress will not save our democracy — Republicans are too much in Trump’s thrall. The Supreme Court will not, they gave our criminal president immunity. Only voters can bring about a real check and balance against this corrupt regime.**
This fight is about more than politics. It’s not a red state, blue state issue. It’s about protecting your right to vote and the very mechanics that make our democracy work. For us, for our kids, for future generations.
[_**Please join me in speaking out against this unconstitutional power grab by the Trump administration. Add your name alongside my own today.**_](https://act.adamschiff.com/signup/EG_2602_VotingRights?refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_PET_AC90_20260216_PM1_V1_S1&t=7&akid=9534%2E5257348%2EiKh4Z7)

---

Thank you for standing with me — for protecting the rule of law, our Constitution, and the right of every American to have their vote counted.
— Adam

name: Major General Paul Eaton, U.S. Army, Ret.
subject: Disgraceful
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY VOTEVETS, VOTEVETS
body:
I write to you now, having witnessed Donald Trump’s ludicrous, self-aggrandizing, politically motivated display at Fort Bragg on Friday. Trump repeatedly railed against Democrats, and told the assembled Troops to vote for Republicans.
#
Peter, this is Paul Eaton.
I write to you now, having witnessed Donald Trump’s ludicrous, self-aggrandizing, politically motivated display at Fort Bragg on Friday.
Trump repeatedly railed against Democrats, and told the assembled Troops to vote for Republicans.
Let me be completely clear about what that was: A disgraceful moment from a disgraced president, and a significant blow to a Military that must be above politics for the good of the nation. The Military reports to the Commander in Chief — no matter their party. This is the bedrock of American democracy.
However, I also write to you after witnessing young men and women in uniform meet those openly political attacks with all of the discipline and bearing we have come to expect from the finest Military in the world.
This is a terrible time for our nation, but even now, I am proud to be an American. I am proud of our Troops, particularly those at Fort Bragg on Friday. Trump will never understand them, because he will never understand what it means to serve something other than himself. And I am more determined than ever to stop this administration from doing further damage to the U.S. Military.
VoteVets leads that fight. We always have, and we always will. And, as we face a critical mid-quarter deadline tonight, I am respectfully asking you for your support.
**[Make a donation of $3 to VoteVets before midnight, when we’ll mark the halfway point to our official, quarterly FEC goal. As one of the most important organizations opposing this administration, we have important fundraising goals to meet. We can’t afford to fall short.**](https://act.votevets.org/go/2927?c0=vv-pac-em-feb26.0dMHx3&refcode=em260216-1-120&t=1&akid=34947%2E3013755%2EaZkaW6)

clean_body: We The People can’t let them get away with this. | Peter, When it comes to polling, there’s certain organizations you simply can’t trust. I know that better than anyone... That’s why it’s so vital that we conduct our own polling, especially when there’s a discrepancy with the numbers like what we’re seeing right now. On one hand, polling shows voters prefer Republicans over Democrats on nearly every key issue: National Security: Immigration: Foreign policy: Trade: National debt: But at the same time, polling by the mainstream media shows Democrats have surged out to a whopping on the generic ballot for the midterms. Something doesn’t add up... But the only way to do that is to have EVERY Republican and swing voter verify their voter profile before the upcoming verification deadline. subject: Support Minneapolis families in need

body:
Our communities continue to face economic hardship and an environment of fear and intimidation after months of ICE occupation
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=2090%2E791427%2EnGrj4t)
Friend, this team has helped raise tens of thousands of dollars for charities and mutual aid networks here in Minnesota over the last few weeks, and I’m eternally grateful.
Our communities continue to face economic hardship and an environment of fear and intimidation after months of ICE and Border Patrol’s violence and harassment. Many families have had to miss work and are quickly falling behind on making ends meet. Local and immigrant-owned small businesses have lost millions in revenue.
That’s why I’m reaching out to ask for your help once again, this time to [**support Pillsbury United Communities’s Rapid Response Fund with a donation.**](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/4916?utm_source=em260216-1-180&t=2&akid=2090%2E791427%2EnGrj4t)

PUC is aiming to raise $1.5 million to support 250 families in need. If everyone reading this email today chipped in, even just $5 or $10, we would put them well on the way towards meeting that goal.
What do you say?

Thank you so much for lending a helping hand to my district and my community.
In solidarity,
— Ilhan
