name: Nate Bundy - John's Political Director
subject: Why I Came Back to Politics - And Why I Support John
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Padora for Colorado
body:
I walked away from politics - until I met a candidate who refuses to be bought.

| [|
---](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/QKEahr__PJvqQu0gQfTEow~~/AAUS1hA~/i6OwtMFMvE_EOxKrWTHNeBYKDkGO8db7RVf9-aLWiYfWCThzQMBoFOPRxBeFdrjAQyjKq75Y-BDeE-qiAe4ogu4pI3rC9rg-2R5utzd1KM4cIPihsuCp1XXlG_iEyRT5)
| | **Friend,** My name is Nate Bundy, and I am working to elect **John Padora** to Colorado’s 4th Congressional District. A few years ago, I walked away from politics. Not because I stopped caring - but because I cared too much. I was exhausted by the fear tactics, the fake urgency, the empty slogans. I was tired of party leadership squeezing working people for donations while protecting the same insiders and consultants who benefit from the system. I was tired of candidates claiming they opposed corporate corruption while quietly relying on the same networks of **Super PAC and dark money funding** that poison our democracy. I watched good and honest people get crushed by big money machines. I watched power brokers protect their influence instead of protecting the Constitution. And I could not be part of that anymore. Then Trump won again. I watched corruption deepen. I watched constitutional norms erode. I watched a Congress too timid or too compromised to defend the basic promise of this country - that **no one is above the law and no one rules as a king**. So I stepped back in. At a protest in Northern Colorado, I stood shoulder to shoulder with my neighbors declaring what should be obvious in a democracy - **there are NO KINGS in America**. That is where I met John Padora. But I did not just take him at his word. I reviewed his financial disclosures. He refuses **Super PAC money** \- and refuses donations from the same corporate networks that fund them. I attended his town hall and asked him hard questions about economic inequality, immigration, civil rights, and corporate power. Real questions that require courage and nuance. He did not dodge. He did not posture. He answered with honesty and humility. For the first time in my life, I made a political donation. It was one dollar. Not because that is all the campaign needs - but because it meant something to me. It was my statement that **democracy should belong to working people, not corporate shareholders**. That public service is not for sale. That leadership should answer to communities - not consultants. Since then, I have given my time and energy to this campaign because I believe it represents something bigger than one election. It represents a fight for **integrity, economic justice, and a democracy that actually works for the people who power it**. Now I am asking you to join us. clean_body: I walked away from politics - until I met a candidate who refuses to be bought. | | | Friend, My name is Nate Bundy, and I am working to elect John Padora to Colorado’s 4th Congressional District. A few years ago, I walked away from politics. Not because I stopped caring - but because I cared too much. I was exhausted by the fear tactics, the fake urgency, the empty slogans. I was tired of party leadership squeezing working people for donations while protecting the same insiders and consultants who benefit from the system. I was tired of candidates claiming they opposed corporate corruption while quietly relying on the same networks of Super PAC and dark money funding that poison our democracy. I watched good and honest people get crushed by big money machines. I watched power brokers protect their influence instead of protecting the Constitution. And I could not be part of that anymore. Then Trump won again. I watched corruption deepen. I watched constitutional norms erode. I watched a Congress too timid or too compromised to defend the basic promise of this country - that no one is above the law and no one rules as a king. So I stepped back in. At a protest in Northern Colorado, I stood shoulder to shoulder with my neighbors declaring what should be obvious in a democracy - there are NO KINGS in America. That is where I met John Padora. But I did not just take him at his word. I reviewed his financial disclosures. He refuses Super PAC money \- and refuses donations from the same corporate networks that fund them. I attended his town hall and asked him hard questions about economic inequality, immigration, civil rights, and corporate power. Real questions that require courage and nuance. He did not dodge. He did not posture. He answered with honesty and humility. For the first time in my life, I made a political donation. It was one dollar. Not because that is all the campaign needs - but because it meant something to me. It was my statement that democracy should belong to working people, not corporate shareholders. That public service is not for sale. That leadership should answer to communities - not consultants. Since then, I have given my time and energy to this campaign because I believe it represents something bigger than one election. It represents a fight for integrity, economic justice, and a democracy that actually works for the people who power it. Now I am asking you to join us. If you can contribute financially, give what feels right. This campaign is powered by people who believe our politics can be honest again. If you cannot give today, give your time. Volunteer. Peter,

Presidents' Day was never meant to be a celebration of just one man.

It's a reminder of something far more important: in America, we don't have kings. We have a Constitution.

We have checks and balances, and we have a democracy built on the idea that no one— _not even the president_ —is above the law. That's part of what makes this country so great and ensures our democracy thrives.

Donald Trump has repeatedly tested the boundaries of our Constitution. He's continued to question the results of a free and fair 2020 election, attacked and tried to silence journalists who report the truth, targeted political opponents, and stacked the courts with judges who will carry out his political agenda.

Presidents' Day should remind us that the presidency is a public trust—not a personal weapon. And leadership means defending the rule of law, not bending it to serve yourself. Kim believes deeply in the Constitution and in the idea that our government answers to the people. She's in Congress to protect our democratic institutions, to stand up to extremism, and make sure no president of either party undermines the freedoms we all depend on and deserve.

clean_body: When our country feels like it's heading in the wrong direction, we are not powerless. Peter, Presidents' Day was never meant to be a celebration of just one man. It's a reminder of something far more important: in America, we don't have kings. We have a Constitution. We have checks and balances, and we have a democracy built on the idea that no one— not even the president —is above the law. That's part of what makes this country so great and ensures our democracy thrives. Donald Trump has repeatedly tested the boundaries of our Constitution. He's continued to question the results of a free and fair 2020 election, attacked and tried to silence journalists who report the truth, targeted political opponents, and stacked the courts with judges who will carry out his political agenda. Presidents' Day should remind us that the presidency is a public trust—not a personal weapon. And leadership means defending the rule of law, not bending it to serve yourself. Kim believes deeply in the Constitution and in the idea that our government answers to the people. She's in Congress to protect our democratic institutions, to stand up to extremism, and make sure no president of either party undermines the freedoms we all depend on and deserve. = If you've saved Hi team,

At a time when leadership too often seems driven by power and politics, I’m proud to have the support of someone who truly understands what real leadership looks like.

Janet Napolitano is the epitome of leadership — always measured, always sensible.

As DHS Secretary, she approached the job with competency and integrity. She knew the field. She knew how to get things done without putting lives at risk or using unnecessary force. And she never played partisan games to score political points.

That kind of leadership matters, especially right now.

Janet Napolitano’s example is one we can all look to. It’s the kind of leader I strive to be, and it’s the kind of leadership our country desperately needs in this moment. I’m honored to have her support in this race for Congress in Arizona’s 1st District.

If you believe in leadership that leads with integrity, common sense, and respect for the people it serves, will you chip in to my campaign today? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/mgw_em?refcode=260216_mgw_janet]

Chicago Public Schools desperately needs qualified teachers. But school officials are choosing to discriminate against Christian student teachers rather than fill those vacancies.

The students at Moody Bible Institute are experiencing this discrimination firsthand.

Moody's students are barred from participating in Chicago Public School's student-teaching program. Not because they lack qualifications. Not because they lack passion for serving students. But because Moody exclusively hires staff who affirm and live out its biblical beliefs.

**In other words, Chicago Public Schools is punishing Moody students for attending a college that practices its faith.**

This is an attack on religious freedom--one of the foundational freedoms that has shaped our nation since its inception. Religious schools like Moody Bible Institute have the constitutional right to exclusively hire employees who share their faith and uphold their religious mission. Without this right, religious institutions would lose their very identity and purpose.

Moody's mission is clear: proclaim the gospel and equip people to be biblically grounded, practically trained, and to engage the world through gospel-centered living. For that mission to be credible, its faculty and staff must be unified in both belief and practice.

But when Moody requested a simple religious exemption acknowledging its constitutionally protected rights, the district refused.

**Instead, officials doubled down --effectively telling Moody students that their faith disqualifies them from serving Chicago's public school children.**

Alliance Defending Freedom is representing Moody Bible Institute in a federal lawsuit to challenge this discriminatory exclusion.

**Will you sign our Statement of Support for Moody Bible Institute and stand with them in this critical moment?
**
This isn't an isolated situation. We are watching this pattern repeat nationwide.

In Washington State, **Yakima Union Gospel Mission** serves thousands of homeless individuals every day--offering food, shelter, and the hope of Christ to locals who desperately need it. Yet the state is threatening the Mission because it only hires those who share its Christian beliefs. Now the Mission is in court seeking to protect its right to hire those who share and live out its faith.

Similarly, in Oregon, Youth 71Five Ministries is asking an appeals court to protect its right to receive public benefits without having to give up its right to employ those who share its faith. Youth 71Five Ministries serves at-risk youth, empowering them with the hope of the Gospel. It depends on a staff that shares its biblical beliefs. But officials stripped the ministry of its public funding for only hiring like-minded individuals who ensure that mission goes forward, violating its constitutional freedoms.

When ministries like Moody, Yakima Union Gospel Mission, and Youth 71Five Ministries stand up in court, they are not only protecting their own freedom. They are defending religious freedom and free expression for every American--Christian or not.

**But these battles come with real emotional and personal costs.** Leaders and staff can face hostility, intense public scrutiny, and even open threats. Stand alongside thousands of believers who are praying for Moody during these stressful times.

That's why your voice matters so deeply right now.

# Is Minneapolis fueling anti-ICE chaos by not charging people?
Prosecutors in Minneapolis and Hennepin County **[have filed few charges against disruptive anti-ICE protesters](https://substack.com/redirect/811df948-c91f-4fb7-bb23-02e2e6e82117?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** blockading streets and clashing with officers, despite widespread unrest and public safety risks sparked by federal immigration raids since December 2025.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/811df948-c91f-4fb7-bb23-02e2e6e82117?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Sparse prosecutorial action:** Hennepin County received 21 referrals but filed only nine citations issued directly by police as most low-level offenses go to city prosecutors.
* **City-level leniency shown:** **[Minneapolis City Attorney filed just 15 formal complaints](https://substack.com/redirect/e58a12f9-52e2-4774-bd2c-88736adbf108?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** from recent referrals, while 90 additional misdemeanor citations may resolve administratively without full prosecution.
* **Police shortages hinder enforcement:** MPD staffing remains critically low at around 588 officers--well below charter requirements--leading to fewer arrests and reports amid ongoing protests and violent incidents.
* **Political bias alleged:** Defense attorney Nathan Hansen questions if prosecutors' decisions reflect political leanings, noting Hennepin County Attorney Mary Moriarty's public support for the anti-ICE demonstrations.

* * *
# "The Godfather" legend Robert Duvall dies at 95
Oscar-winning actor Robert Duvall, iconic as Tom Hagen in _The Godfather_ and Lt. Col. Kilgore in _Apocalypse Now_ , **[died peacefully at his Virginia home on Sunday](https://substack.com/redirect/bb572749-97bb-4f40-98ab-fad91a896c21?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** at age 95, his wife Luciana announced.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/00e6602e-32ad-4781-8966-a723720124d7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* **Career-Spanning Triumphs:** Duvall earned an Oscar for _Tender Mercies_ and seven nominations total, starring in classics like _To Kill a Mockingbird_ , _M_ A _S_ H*, and _Lonesome Dove_.
* **Memorable Military Roles:** He delivered the famous "I love the smell of napalm" line as a surfing-obsessed colonel in _Apocalypse Now_ and played a tough Marine in _The Great Santini_.
* **Personal Life Details:** Married to Luciana Pedraza (54) since 2005, Duvall lived on a horse farm in Middleburg, Virginia, and had no children despite four marriages.
* **Wife 's Emotional Tribute:** Luciana posted that Bob was her "everything," praising his passion for acting, storytelling, and simple joys like great meals while requesting privacy.

| Dear Patriot,
A lot of people thought putting Kash Patel in charge of the FBI would change everything. I was hopeful too. [**But an FBI insider just told our hidden camera something that should stop every one of us in our tracks:**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.) **Even with Kash Patel as Director, zero major arrests are coming for the massive Minnesota daycare fraud.** No prison time. Not for the people who stole millions in taxpayer money. Not for any of them. We caught this on tape. And the only reason we could is because donors like you paid to put our journalist in that room. [**Will you help us do it again? Give $35, $50, or $100 right now.**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.) [****](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.) Here’s what makes this so infuriating. This FBI Security Specialist — five years on the job — didn’t blame Kash Patel. He didn’t blame politics. He explained how the **system itself** is designed to kill accountability: Financial fraud cases take “literal years” to build. Every transaction. Every account. Every payment. By the time the case is ready for court, the administration changes, judges toss it, and the whole thing evaporates. Maybe they find one fall guy. Everyone else walks away with your money. It doesn’t matter who’s in charge. The bureaucracy runs out the clock on purpose. And here’s the part that should scare you: **this is not a one-off confession.** This is the 7th FBI or DOJ official we’ve caught on hidden camera admitting the same thing. Seven separate insiders. Seven times they’ve told us — when they didn’t think anyone was recording — that the system protects the guilty. No mainstream outlet has this footage. No Congressional committee demanded these answers. **Our team got them, one hidden camera at a time.** But each of those operations costs real money. And we’re planning more right now. [**Can you chip in today to fund the next one?**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.) Here’s what it actually takes: **[**$35**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)** — one night of undercover fieldwork. That’s what it cost to get this FBI agent talking. **[**$50**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)** — encrypted recording gear that keeps our journalists protected and footage tamper-proof. **[**$100**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)** — legal review before publication. We don’t just record — we make sure it holds up. **[**$250+**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)** — helps launch a full new investigation. We have targets identified. We just need the resources. Think about what’s at stake here. If the FBI’s own people are telling us that leadership changes don’t matter... that the fraud cases will just die on the vine... then the **only** accountability left is what organizations like OMG create. We are the last line. And it’s working. This year, OMG investigations have driven $253 million in federal contracts suspended, triggered a $9 billion Treasury audit, and reached over a million people on YouTube alone. Not opinions. Not hot takes. Documented results. [**Help us keep going. Your best gift of $35, $50, $100, or whatever you can — right now — goes straight to the next investigation.**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.) The bureaucracy is built to wait you out. Let’s not let them.In Truth,
James O'Keefe
Founder and CEO
O'Keefe Media Group

**_P.S._**_Kash Patel took over the FBI to clean house. But this insider says the rot goes deeper than any one director can reach. The fraud cases die because the system is built to let them die. The only thing that changes that equation is sunlight — and that’s what your donation pays for._[**Give now before this story fades from the news cycle.**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)

Fellow Patriot,
